data.name: 0 emits no expiry at all, which is the safe default: an expiry is a promise about mail already in flight, and a window shorter than the delay a retry, a greylist or a mailing list adds costs the message its DKIM pass and its DMARC alignment at the far end. 604800 is a week, the usual choice for a sender who wants one. A signing timestamp is always sent regardless of this value.
data.value: 0 表示完全不发出到期时间，这是安全的默认值：到期时间是对已在传输途中的邮件所作的承诺，而只要这个窗口短于重试、灰名单或邮件列表所增加的延迟，邮件就会在对端失去 DKIM 通过和 DMARC 对齐。604800 是一周，是希望设置到期时间的发件方通常的选择。无论此值为何，签名时间戳都始终会发送。

data.name: 0 is the shipped default and disables the whole mechanism.
data.value: 0 是出厂默认值，会禁用整个机制。

data.value: 0 是出厂默认值。2 是一个合理的起点：密码输错一次只会让人多等两秒，而对密码喷洒的客户端来说，每猜一次要等两秒、四秒、六秒……。

data.name: 0 keeps every message until it is released or deleted, so watch the disk.
data.value: 0 会保留每封邮件，直到它被放行或删除，因此请留意磁盘空间。

data.name: 0 keeps the entry until it is removed.
data.value: 0 表示保留该条目，直到被移除。

data.name: 0 means archives are never deleted. Retention runs on the server after every backup into this folder - scheduled or started by hand with Start backup now - and only once the new archive has been written and verified readable, so a failed backup never deletes anything. The newest archive is never deleted, the age limit always leaves the two newest alone, and only this server's own HMBackup archives are counted - other files in the folder are never touched.
data.value: 0 表示永不删除存档。每次备份到此文件夹之后 - 无论是计划备份还是用“立即开始备份”手动启动的 - 服务器都会执行保留清理，并且只有在新存档写入完毕并验证可读之后才会执行，因此失败的备份绝不会删除任何内容。最新的存档永不删除，按存留期限清理时始终会保留最新的两个，而且只统计本服务器自己的 HMBackup 存档 - 该文件夹中的其他文件绝不会被触碰。

data.value: 对单次遍历的上限，这样即使搜索基准点设得高了一层，也不会靠读取整片林来完成。一旦触及该上限，本次运行会予以说明，并且不会禁用任何内容 - 超出上限之后，存在的条目与已被删除的条目无从区分。

data.value: 已向 {0} 颁发证书，但无法读取它的到期时间：{1}

data.name: A certificate is issued and valid until {0}, {1} day from now. Renewal starts automatically inside the last {2} days.
data.value: 证书已颁发，有效期至 {0}，距今 {1} 天。续期会在最后 {2} 天内自动开始。

data.name: A certificate is issued and valid until {0}, {1} days from now. Renewal starts automatically inside the last {2} days.
data.value: 证书已颁发，有效期至 {0}，距今 {1} 天。续期会在最后 {2} 天内自动开始。

data.name: A code from an authenticator app, required alongside this account's password. It applies where a code can actually be entered - the Control Panel and the API. Mail clients cannot present one, so once this is on they must use an app password instead.
data.value: 来自身份验证器应用的验证码，需与此账户的密码一并使用。它适用于确实能够输入验证码的场合 - 控制面板和 API。邮件客户端无法出示验证码，因此一旦启用此项，它们就必须改用应用密码。

data.name: A copy of a domain's mail, or of one account's, sent to an address - as an envelope report with the message attached, or as the message itself.
data.value: 把某个域或某个账户的邮件副本发往一个地址：作为附有该邮件的信封报告，或者作为邮件本身。

data.name: A copy of a domain's mail, or of one account's, sent to an address - as an envelope report with the message attached, or as the message itself. Nothing is copied until a rule exists here, and a rule is not the archive: it sends mail elsewhere rather than keeping files on this machine.
data.value: 把某个域或某个账户的邮件副本发往一个地址：作为附有该邮件的信封报告，或者作为邮件本身。在这里没有规则之前不会复制任何内容；规则不是归档，它把邮件发往别处，而不是在这台机器上保留文件。

data.name: A copy of every log entry, as RFC 5424, to a syslog collector - rsyslog, syslog-ng, a SIEM - beside the log files rather than instead of them. On Linux with no collector named, a server running under systemd writes to the journal, where journalctl can read it.
data.value: 将每条日志条目按 RFC 5424 复制一份发送到 syslog 收集器（rsyslog、syslog-ng 或 SIEM），与日志文件并存而不是取代它们。在 Linux 上若未指定收集器，运行于 systemd 下的服务器会写入 journal，可用 journalctl 读取。

data.name: A credential is set but the listener has no TLS, so the credential crosses the network in clear text on every scrape and can be replayed by anyone on the path. Set the certificate and key files, or bind to 127.0.0.1. The server still starts - it logs this same warning.
data.value: 已设置凭据，但监听器没有 TLS，因此凭据会在每次抓取时以明文穿越网络，路径上的任何人都可以重放它。请设置证书和密钥文件，或者绑定到 127.0.0.1。服务器仍会启动 - 它会记录这条同样的警告。

data.name: A criterion of the rule “{0}”.
data.value: 规则“{0}”的条件。

data.name: A custom virus scanner or external tool that hangs - bounded by 'External process timeout' on the Server limits & expert settings page.
data.value: 会挂起的自定义病毒扫描器或外部工具 - 由“服务器限制和专家设置”页上的“外部进程超时”限定。

data.name: A delivery between two hard bounces starts the count again. A refusal this server cannot trust as a dead mailbox - a bare 550 with no enhanced code, a policy refusal, its own connection failures - never counts.
data.value: 两次硬退信之间只要有一次投递成功，计数就会重新开始。本服务器无法确信为邮箱不存在的拒绝（不带扩展代码的单纯 550、策略拒绝、服务器自身的连接失败）永远不计入。

data.name: A delivery report
data.value: 投递报告

data.name: A directory photo is at most 100 KB.
data.value: 通讯录照片最大 100 KB。

data.name: A domain - the server needs one before it can receive mail
data.value: 一个域 - 服务器需要先有一个域才能接收邮件

data.name: A domain hosted on this server
data.value: 本服务器上托管的一个域

data.name: A domain is required.
data.value: 需要一个域。

data.name: A domain may issue S/MIME certificates to its people from its own authority.
data.value: 域可以用自己的证书颁发机构为其用户颁发 S/MIME 证书。

data.name: A domain name here needs the SERVER's own computer to be joined to that domain, because Windows validates it with LogonUser. From a computer that is not joined, every attempt fails as though the password were wrong - including when the domain name is simply misspelt - so a mailbox configured this way on an unjoined server can never sign in and never says why. If the server is not domain-joined, use LDAP directory authentication on the Directory authentication (LDAP) page instead: it binds to the directory over the network and needs no domain join.
data.value: 在此处填写域名，要求服务器本机加入该域，因为 Windows 是用 LogonUser 来验证的。在未加入域的计算机上，每一次尝试都会像密码错误一样失败 - 包括仅仅是域名拼写有误的情况 - 因此在未加入域的服务器上这样配置的邮箱永远无法登录，也永远不会说明原因。如果服务器未加入域，请改用“目录身份验证（LDAP）”页上的 LDAP 目录身份验证：它通过网络绑定到目录，不需要加入域。

data.name: A domain named {0} is already on this server, and it is not the sample domain this page makes, so no sample can be made here and this page will not remove it. If you do not want that domain, delete it on the Domains page.
data.value: 此服务器上已有一个名为 {0} 的域，但它不是本页创建的样例域，因此无法在此创建样例，本页也不会移除它。如果您不需要该域，请在“域”页面上删除它。

data.name: A domain or an account address is required.
data.value: 需要一个域或一个账户地址。

data.name: A domain with rotating outbound hosts is usually recognised by the HELO name; a domain that forges nothing by its envelope sender.
data.value: 出站主机不断变化的域通常通过 HELO 名称识别；不伪造任何内容的域通过信封发件人识别。

data.name: A domain, a mailbox, a listener that offers TLS, and what the dashboard makes of it. Four minutes; leave whenever you like.
data.value: 一个域、一个邮箱、一个提供 TLS 的监听器，以及仪表板对这一切的判断。四分钟；随时可以退出。

data.name: A domain, or an account address
data.value: 域或账户地址

data.name: A file of a submitted type in a message from outside is sent to a sandbox you run or subscribe to, and the message waits - in no mailbox and not in the quarantine - for its verdict: clean is delivered, malicious is quarantined. Nothing is held until both addresses are set and this is on.
data.value: 来自外部的邮件中属于提交类型的文件，会被发送到您运营或订阅的沙箱，邮件则在不进入任何邮箱、也不进入隔离区的情况下等待其判定：干净的会被投递，恶意的会被隔离。在设置两个地址并打开此选项之前，不会保留任何邮件。

data.name: A grace for incoming mail: a mailbox over its limit by less than this still receives, so a person away for a week does not lose mail because a large attachment arrived on Monday. The owner's own saves and copies stop at the limit itself. Each domain may set its own. Applies at once.
data.value: 来信的宽限：超出限额不到此值的邮箱仍可收信，这样外出一周的人不会因周一收到一个大附件而丢失邮件。所有者自己的保存和复制在限额处即止。每个域可各自设置。立即生效。

data.name: A group exists so that several accounts can be given the same rights at once - grant the group access to a public folder under Public folders, and every account listed here gets that access. An empty group grants nothing to anyone.
data.value: 设立组是为了一次性给若干账户授予相同的权限 - 在“公用文件夹”中把某个公用文件夹的访问权限授予该组，此处列出的每个账户就都获得该访问权限。空组不会给任何人授予任何权限。

data.name: A host name, not an address. Set a parent domain when the webmail and the Control Deck are reached at several names, so that one passkey works at all of them.
data.value: 是主机名，而不是地址。当通过多个名称访问网页邮箱和 Control Deck 时，请设置上级域，使一个通行密钥在所有名称下都可用。

data.name: A key is published only while the server's switch on the Webmail page and the domain's, in the domain's dialog, are on as well.
data.value: 只有当“网页邮箱”页面上的服务器开关和域对话框中的域开关也都打开时，密钥才会发布。

data.name: A key rotation is staged (selector "{0}"). The staged record and the promote step are managed from the domain's DKIM tab, which gates promotion on its own DNS check; it is deliberately not repeated here.
data.value: 已暂存一次密钥轮换（选择器 "{0}"）。暂存的记录和提升步骤在该域的 DKIM 选项卡中管理，那里会以自身的 DNS 检查作为提升的前提；此处刻意不重复这些操作。

data.name: A key with a domain list is also refused the delivery-queue endpoints, because the queue is server-wide and cannot be filtered by domain.
data.value: 带有域列表的密钥同样会被拒绝访问投递队列端点，因为队列是服务器范围的，无法按域过滤。

data.name: A label is required. It is how this key is told apart from the others months from now.
data.value: 必须填写标签。几个月之后，正是靠它把这个密钥与其他密钥区分开。

data.name: A listener wants a certificate and STARTTLS, so that no password crosses the network in the clear.
data.value: 监听器需要证书和 STARTTLS，这样就不会有密码以明文形式穿过网络。

data.name: A low rate on a busy server usually means the TTL is shorter than the interval between lookups of the same object; a rate of 0% with no memory in use means nothing has been looked up yet, which is not the same thing. Memory in use is measured against the size caps above, and a cache at its cap is evicting entries it would otherwise have kept.
data.value: 在繁忙的服务器上命中率偏低，通常意味着 TTL 短于对同一对象两次查询之间的间隔；而命中率为 0% 且没有占用内存，则表示还没有查询过任何内容，这是两回事。占用的内存是相对于上面的容量上限来衡量的，达到上限的缓存会逐出本来可以保留的条目。

data.name: A mail client signs in with a password, and from any address but this computer's the password should cross the network only inside TLS.
data.value: 邮件客户端使用密码登录；从本计算机以外的任何地址，密码都应只在 TLS 内穿过网络。

data.name: A mail server usually starts with the rest of the machine, and on a machine where the database service starts second, the first few attempts fail. Together with the delay below this is the whole window: six attempts five seconds apart is half a minute. Lengthen it rather than delaying the service if the database is on another host that is slower to come up.
data.value: 邮件服务器通常随机器的其余部分一起启动，而在数据库服务较晚启动的机器上，最初几次尝试会失败。它与下面的延迟共同构成整个窗口：每隔五秒尝试一次、共六次，就是半分钟。如果数据库位于另一台启动较慢的主机上，请延长它，而不是延迟服务本身。

data.name: A marked message is changed in no visible way: no X-hMailServer-Spam header, no reason header and no subject prefix, so a mail client has nothing to file on. The internal spam flag is still set, which suppresses auto-replies and forwarding for accounts configured that way.
data.value: 被标记的邮件在外观上不会有任何变化：没有 X-hMailServer-Spam 标头，没有原因标头，也没有主题前缀，因此邮件客户端无从据以归类。内部的垃圾邮件标志仍会设置，这会对做了相应配置的账户抑制自动回复和转发。

data.name: A message above this is passed without being sent to the engine, because sending a large attachment across the network costs more than the answer is worth. 0 removes the ceiling, which is reasonable for an engine on this machine.
data.value: 超过此大小的邮件会直接放行，不再送交引擎，因为通过网络发送大附件的代价大于答案的价值。0 表示取消该上限，对于运行在本机上的引擎这是合理的。

data.name: A message not on the local disk is looked for in the object store while one is named, so switching back hides nothing. Taken within five seconds.
data.value: 不在本地磁盘上的邮件，只要指定了对象存储，就会到那里查找，因此切换回来不会隐藏任何内容。五秒内生效。

data.name: A message scoring {0} or more is marked as spam and delivered. Nothing is refused on score.
data.value: 分数达到 {0} 或以上的邮件会被标记为垃圾邮件并投递。不会因分数而拒收任何邮件。

data.name: A message scoring {0} or more is marked as spam and delivered; {1} or more is refused (550 before the body, 554 after it).
data.value: 分数达到 {0} 或以上的邮件会被标记为垃圾邮件并投递；达到 {1} 或以上的会被拒收（正文之前为 550，之后为 554）。

data.name: A message scoring {0} or more is refused (550 before the body, 554 after it). None is only marked: the mark threshold, {1}, is not below that.
data.value: 分数达到 {0} 或以上的邮件会被拒收（正文之前为 550，之后为 554）。没有邮件只被标记：标记阈值 {1} 并不低于它。

data.name: A message scoring {0} or more is refused (550 before the body, 554 after it). Nothing is marked.
data.value: 分数达到 {0} 或以上的邮件会被拒收（正文之前为 550，之后为 554）。不会标记任何邮件。

data.name: A message to ten local mailboxes is written once and linked ten times rather than copied ten times, which is the difference between one disk write and ten for a large message to a distribution list. Needs the data directory on NTFS; where a link cannot be made the server copies the file and says so in the SMTP log.
data.value: 发给十个本地邮箱的邮件只写入一次并建立十个链接，而不是复制十份；对于发往分发列表的大邮件来说，这就是一次磁盘写入与十次磁盘写入的区别。需要数据目录位于 NTFS 上；在无法建立链接的地方，服务器会复制文件并在 SMTP 日志中说明。

data.name: A modern administration app for hMailServer: live dashboard, domains and accounts, delivery queue, log streaming, full server settings and the 6.x transport-security features (DANE, MTA-STS, ARC, TLS-RPT, ACME).
data.value: 面向 hMailServer 的现代管理应用：实时仪表板、域与账户、投递队列、日志流、完整的服务器设置，以及 6.x 的传输安全功能（DANE、MTA-STS、ARC、TLS-RPT、ACME）。

data.name: A name is required.
data.value: 名称为必填项。

data.name: A new address is required.
data.value: 需要新地址。

data.name: A new key pair was made. The public key is {0}. Open the page again to see it above.
data.value: 已生成新的密钥对。公钥为 {0}。重新打开页面即可在上方看到它。

data.name: A new key was generated and staged. Publish its record.
data.value: 已生成并准备好新密钥。请发布它的记录。

data.name: A new photo has been chosen; it is saved with the account.
data.value: 已选择新照片，将随帐户一起保存。

data.name: A new service account password has been typed, and "Remove the stored service account password when saving" is ticked under it. Clear the password or untick the box - guessing which was meant is not this page's decision to make.
data.value: 既输入了新的服务账户密码，又勾选了其下方的“保存时移除已存储的服务账户密码”。请清除该密码或取消勾选 - 猜测您的本意不是本页应当作出的决定。

data.name: A new value has been typed for "{0}", and "Remove the stored secret when saving" is ticked under it. Clear the value or untick the box - guessing which was meant is not this page's decision to make.
data.value: 既为“{0}”输入了新值，又勾选了其下方的“保存时移除已存储的机密”。请清除该值或取消勾选 - 猜测您的本意不是本页应当作出的决定。

data.name: A notice is sent to the envelope sender of every infected message. Virus senders forge that address almost without exception, so this mostly delivers mail to people who did not send anything — which is backscatter, and it is what gets a server onto a block list.
data.value: 会向每一封受感染邮件的信封发件人发送通知。病毒发送方几乎无一例外地伪造该地址，因此这多半只是把邮件投递给什么都没发过的人 — 这就是反向散射，也正是让服务器进入拦截列表的原因。

data.name: A one-time code required in addition to the administrator password, checked by the SERVER - so it applies to every client of that credential: this Control Panel, scripts using the COM API, and the REST API (which reads the code from an X-hMailServer-OTP header). The secret is stored on the server, in hMailServer.ini, machine-protected. It makes the administrator password worthless on its own. Keep the setup key safe: if the authenticator is lost, a local administrator deletes AdministratorTotpSecret from the [Security] section of hMailServer.ini, with an editor run as administrator, and restarts the hMailServer service.
data.value: 除管理员密码之外还需要的一次性验证码，由服务器校验 - 因此它适用于该凭据的每一个客户端：本控制面板、使用 COM API 的脚本，以及 REST API（后者从 X-hMailServer-OTP 标头读取验证码）。该机密存储在服务器上的 hMailServer.ini 中，受计算机级保护。它使管理员密码本身不再足以登录。请妥善保管设置密钥：如果身份验证器丢失，由本地管理员用以管理员身份运行的编辑器从 hMailServer.ini 的 [Security] 节中删除 AdministratorTotpSecret，然后重新启动 hMailServer 服务。

data.name: A passphrase is already stored for '{0}'. Saving replaces it - the old one cannot be recovered from here. Replace it?
data.value: '{0}' 已存储了一个密码短语。保存会将其替换 - 旧的密码短语无法从此处恢复。是否替换？

data.name: A passphrase is set: the archive is encrypted as it is written, file names included, and a restore asks for the passphrase.
data.value: 已设置口令：存档在写入时就已加密，文件名也在内，还原时会要求输入口令。

data.name: A passphrase is stored for this certificate. It is never displayed here - saving a new one replaces it. Whether it is the RIGHT passphrase is only proven when the server loads the key: after the next restart, check the application error log.
data.value: 此证书已存储了密码短语。它绝不会在此显示 - 保存新的会替换旧的。它是否为正确的密码短语，只有在服务器加载密钥时才能证明：请在下次重启之后查看应用程序错误日志。

data.name: A passphrase is stored, but the key file is not encrypted, so it is never used. Harmless - it simply does nothing.
data.value: 已存储密码短语，但密钥文件并未加密，因此它从不会被使用。这没有害处 - 只是不起任何作用。

data.name: A password is stored - leave blank to keep it
data.value: 已存储密码 - 留空则保持不变

data.name: A person
data.value: 人员

data.name: A piece of equipment
data.value: 设备

data.name: A profile for this server
data.value: 此服务器的配置方案

data.name: A profile sets the thirty or so settings one kind of server needs - which, to what and why - shows the difference from this server before anything changes, and keeps what it replaces so that it can be put back.
data.value: 配置方案会设置某类服务器所需的约三十项设置——设置哪些、设为何值、为何如此——在任何更改之前显示与此服务器的差异，并保留它所替换的值以便恢复。

data.name: A quota can be set on the domain and overridden per account.
data.value: 可以在域上设置配额，并在账户上逐个覆盖。

data.name: A random server-wide secret
data.value: 服务器范围内的一个随机机密

data.name: A random token Prometheus will present on every scrape
data.value: Prometheus 在每次抓取时出示的随机令牌

data.name: A reachable directory server. The hMailServer machine must reach the host above on the effective port (636 for LDAPS, 389 otherwise) through any firewall in between. A DMZ host usually needs a rule added for exactly this.
data.value: 一台可访问的目录服务器。hMailServer 所在的计算机必须能够穿过中间的任何防火墙，在有效端口（LDAPS 为 636，其余为 389）上访问上面的主机。DMZ 中的主机通常正需要为此添加一条规则。

data.name: A read-only SNMP agent for a monitoring system: SNMPv3 with authentication and encryption, and SNMPv2c only if you switch it on. It answers nobody until the managers are listed, and the port has to be open to them in any firewall between.
data.value: 供监控系统使用的只读 SNMP 代理：带认证和加密的 SNMPv3，只有在你打开时才支持 SNMPv2c。在列出管理站之前它不会应答任何人，并且路径上的每个防火墙都必须为它们打开该端口。

data.name: A recipient domain with several MX hosts is worth more attempts than one with a single host, because a retry can land on a different server. This multiplies the retry count above by the number of MX hosts actually tried.
data.value: 拥有多台 MX 主机的收件人域值得多尝试几次，因为重试可能落到另一台服务器上。此项会把上面的重试次数乘以实际尝试过的 MX 主机数。

data.name: A remote server that answers extremely slowly. The idle timeout is re-armed on every byte, so a host that sends one byte occasionally used to hold a delivery thread indefinitely; 'Absolute lifetime of one client session' (30 minutes by default) is the absolute ceiling, armed once and never re-armed.
data.value: 应答极其缓慢的远程服务器。空闲超时会在每个字节到达时重新计时，因此偶尔发送一个字节的主机过去可以无限期占用一个投递线程；“一个客户端会话的绝对生存期”（默认 30 分钟）是绝对上限，只计时一次，绝不重新计时。

data.name: A reply for the whole domain - a closed office, a decommissioned department. It answers only for accounts that have NO vacation message of their own: an account's own message always wins, and at most one reply answers any message.
data.value: 面向整个域的回复 - 例如关闭的办公室、撤销的部门。它只为没有自己的休假回复的账户作答：账户自己的回复始终优先，而且对任何一封邮件最多只有一条回复。

data.name: A role is a named set of permissions, and an assignment gives one to an account in named domains. The four built-in roles cannot be edited: their permissions are in the server's code so that a change to the database cannot hand somebody authority. An account with no role here holds whatever its admin level has always given it.
data.value: 角色是一组有名字的权限，分配把它授予指定域中的某个账户。四个内置角色无法编辑：它们的权限写在服务器代码中，这样改动数据库也无法给谁增加权限。在这里没有角色的账户，拥有其管理员级别一直赋予它的权限。

data.name: A room
data.value: 会议室

data.name: A room or a piece of equipment answers the meeting invitations it is sent by itself, and nobody can sign in as it on any protocol, whatever its password. Its booking policy is set in the Control Deck.
data.value: 会议室或设备会自行答复发给它的会议邀请，无论密码是什么，任何人都无法通过任何协议以它的身份登录。其预订策略在 Control Deck 中设置。

data.name: A route overrides MX lookup for named domains.
data.value: 路由会为指定的域覆盖 MX 查询。

data.name: A scan that errors, times out or cannot reach its engine is not a clean verdict: nobody looked.
data.value: 出错、超时或者连不上引擎的扫描不是一个明确的结论：等于没有人看过。

data.name: A scanner that cannot run does not refuse the message. The error is written to the log and the scan continues to the next scanner; when none of them can answer, the message is held and scanned again, and returned to its sender when the holds run out (If a message cannot be scanned, on the Anti-virus settings page). That is why this page reports whether each scanner can run rather than whether it is switched on.
data.value: 无法运行的扫描器并不会拒收邮件。错误会写入日志，扫描继续交给下一个扫描器；当所有扫描器都无法作答时，该邮件会被暂挂并再次扫描，暂挂次数用完后退回给发件人（“反病毒设置”页面上的“如果邮件无法扫描”）。这正是本页报告每个扫描器是否能够运行、而不是报告它是否被打开的原因。

data.name: A scanner that cannot run does not refuse the message. The error is written to the log and the scan continues to the next scanner; when none of them can answer, the message is treated exactly as if it had been examined and found clean. That is why this page reports whether each scanner can run rather than whether it is switched on.
data.value: 无法运行的扫描器并不会拒收邮件。错误会写入日志，扫描继续交给下一个扫描器；当所有扫描器都无法作答时，该邮件会被完全当作已经检查过且未发现问题来处理。这正是本页报告每个扫描器是否能够运行、而不是报告它是否被打开的原因。

data.name: A scanner working through 203.0.113.10, .11 and .12 under one reverse domain earns a ban and a firewall rule for each. With this on, the ban is still written at once for the one address, and then widened in the background to the run of addresses around it, inside its /24, whose reverse names share its registrable domain: one range and one firewall rule, said in the application log.
data.value: 一个在同一反向域下依次尝试 203.0.113.10、.11 和 .12 的扫描器，会为每个地址各得到一个封禁和一条防火墙规则。启用此项后，封禁仍会立即只针对该地址写入，然后在后台扩展到其 /24 内、反向名称共享其可注册域的周围连续地址：一个范围、一条防火墙规则，并记入应用程序日志。

data.name: A schedule creates and updates accounts with nobody watching. It never disables one, whatever the checkbox above is set to - departures are left to a person who has read a preview. Switch this on only after a preview has told you what it is going to do.
data.value: 计划会在无人看管的情况下创建和更新账户。无论上面的复选框如何设置，它都绝不会禁用账户 - 人员离职留给已经看过预览的人来处理。请只在预览已经告诉您它将要做什么之后，再打开此项。

data.name: A schedule is configured: daily at {0:00}:{1:00}, server local time.
data.value: 已配置计划：每天 {0:00}:{1:00}，服务器本地时间。

data.name: A schedule is configured: one backup every {0} minute.
data.value: 已配置计划：每 {0} 分钟备份一次。

data.name: A schedule is configured: one backup every {0} minutes.
data.value: 已配置计划：每 {0} 分钟备份一次。

data.name: A second factor for the administrator - a one-time code beside the password
data.value: 管理员的第二因素 - 密码之外的一次性代码

data.name: A second factor is enrolled. This account's own password no longer signs in to mail clients - only its app passwords do. Removing the second factor restores it.
data.value: 已注册第二重验证。此账户自身的密码不再能登录邮件客户端 - 只有它的应用密码可以。删除第二重验证会恢复原状。

data.name: A second factor is enrolled: every sign-in with the administrator credential - this tool, the COM API and the REST API - needs a code. Turning it off removes that requirement, and the administrator password alone signs in again.
data.value: 已注册第二重验证：使用管理员凭据的每一次登录 - 本工具、COM API 和 REST API - 都需要验证码。将其关闭会取消这一要求，仅凭管理员密码即可再次登录。

data.name: A secret is configured — leave blank to keep it
data.value: 已配置机密 — 留空则保持不变

data.name: A separate ceiling from the time limit, because a search that reads enormous amounts of message content is expensive even when it finishes quickly.
data.value: 与时间限制分开的另一个上限，因为读取大量邮件内容的搜索即使很快完成，代价也很高。

data.name: A separate password for one mail client. Losing a laptop then means revoking one line here, rather than changing the account password and reconfiguring every other client.
data.value: 供一个邮件客户端单独使用的密码。这样，丢失一台笔记本电脑只需在此撤销一行，而不必更改账户密码并重新配置其他所有客户端。

data.name: A service account password from an earlier version is stored in hMailServer.INI in plain text, and nothing reads it any more: the service is registered from the installer or the buttons on the Windows service account card, and Windows keeps its own copy of any password. Delete the ServiceAccountPassword line from hMailServer.INI with an elevated editor, and the setting with DELETE /api/v1/settings/ini/ServiceAccountPassword, so that the database's copy goes too.
data.value: 早期版本的服务账户密码以明文形式保存在 hMailServer.INI 中，而且已不再被任何程序读取：服务由安装程序或“Windows 服务账户”卡片上的按钮注册，Windows 会自行保存每个密码的副本。请用以管理员身份运行的编辑器从 hMailServer.INI 中删除 ServiceAccountPassword 行，并用 DELETE /api/v1/settings/ini/ServiceAccountPassword 删除该设置，使数据库中的副本也一并删除。

data.name: A session that greets with HELO 192.0.2.7, HELO [192.0.2.7] or HELO localhost, or sends MAIL FROM:<user@192.0.2.7>, has given no name for itself, and a message it sends is held or scored with nothing to list it by. Off, the server accepts it as it always has. On, it is answered 550 5.7.1 at MAIL FROM, before the spam tests run: an address with or without brackets, a single label, a public suffix such as co.uk, and anything that is not a host name are refused, while mail.co.uk is a name. No DNS is asked; the suffixes are the Public Suffix List's, the list the quarantine groups by. Only unauthenticated sessions of an IP range that runs the spam tests are judged, after AUTH has had its chance - never a sender in the spam exemptions, and never an incoming relay, whose HELO is your own gateway's.
data.value: 以 HELO 192.0.2.7、HELO [192.0.2.7] 或 HELO localhost 问候、或发送 MAIL FROM:<user@192.0.2.7> 的会话，没有为自己给出任何名称，它发送的邮件会被暂扣或计分，却没有任何可据以列入名单的依据。关闭时，服务器像以往一样接受它。开启时，在运行反垃圾邮件测试之前，于 MAIL FROM 阶段回应 550 5.7.1：带或不带方括号的地址、单个标签、co.uk 这样的公共后缀，以及任何不是主机名的内容都会被拒绝，而 mail.co.uk 是名称。不查询 DNS；后缀来自 Public Suffix List，即隔离区分组所用的列表。只评判来自运行反垃圾邮件测试的 IP 范围的未认证会话，且在 AUTH 有机会完成之后进行；绝不评判反垃圾邮件豁免中的发件人，也绝不评判 HELO 属于您自己网关的传入中继。

data.name: A share of connections, never more than the delivery threads: the accounts of one hosted domain, or all relayed mail together, cannot hold every delivery thread. The per-account sending limit is the volume control; this is not one.
data.value: 这是连接的份额，永远不超过投递线程数：一个托管域名的账户，或全部中继邮件加在一起，都不能占用所有投递线程。控制数量的是每账户发送上限；这不是。

data.name: A short built-in list - "password", "123456", "changeme" and about thirty more - compared without regard to case. It is deliberately not a "top 10000" list, which would need a data file and an update path; it catches the passwords that get typed while setting up a mailbox nobody comes back to.
data.value: 一份简短的内置列表 - "password"、"123456"、"changeme" 以及另外三十来个 - 比较时不区分大小写。它有意不是“前 10000 名”那种列表，那需要一个数据文件和一条更新途径；它拦截的是在建立一个此后无人再管的邮箱时随手输入的那些密码。

data.name: A simple bind needs the user's distinguished name. There are two ways to get one - search for it, or compute it from a template - and Negotiate needs neither, because SSPI authenticates by user name and domain, which the account already carries.
data.value: 简单绑定需要用户的可分辨名称。获取它有两种方式 - 搜索，或者按模板推算 - 而 Negotiate 两者都不需要，因为 SSPI 是按用户名和域进行身份验证的，而账户本身就带着这些信息。

data.name: A single DNS query. 0 = no bound.
data.value: 单次 DNS 查询。0 = 不限制。

data.name: A spam trap is an address in one of your domains that nobody uses, so whoever writes to it is sending spam. These settings say what happens to a server that does. The trap addresses are declared per domain in the Control Deck; until a domain has one, nothing here does anything.
data.value: 垃圾邮件陷阱是你某个域中无人使用的地址，因此向它写信的人就是在发送垃圾邮件。这些设置决定这样做的服务器会遭遇什么。陷阱地址在 Control Deck 中按域声明；在域还没有任何陷阱地址时，这里的设置都不起作用。

data.name: A successful logon clears the name's counters, and attempts made while it is locked are not counted - so an attacker cannot hold a mailbox locked indefinitely with a trickle of guesses.
data.value: 一次成功登录会清除该名称的计数器，而锁定期间的尝试不计入计数 - 因此攻击者无法靠涓滴式的猜测把一个邮箱无限期地锁住。

data.name: A triplet retried too soon this many times is answered 550 instead of 451 for the lock below, which is what stops a sender hammering the same message every few seconds. A misconfigured retry loop is stranded until the lock passes, after which the triplet starts over as a first attempt.
data.value: 过早重试达到这么多次的三元组，在下方锁定期间会收到 550 而不是 451，这正是阻止发件人每隔几秒反复投递同一封邮件的办法。配置错误的重试循环会被困住直到锁定结束，之后三元组作为首次尝试重新开始。

data.name: A triplet that has been seen before but has not yet been confirmed sits in a window before its record expires. Turning this off lets mail through during that window instead of greylisting it again, which is gentler on senders that retry slowly and weaker against a sender that retries once.
data.value: 此前见过、但尚未确认的三元组会在其记录到期之前处于一个窗口期内。关闭此项会让该窗口期内的邮件直接通过，而不是再次以灰名单拦截，这对重试较慢的发件方更友好，对只重试一次的发件方则防护更弱。

data.name: A v=STSv1 record is live at {0} with id {1}. The id being different from the suggestion is fine - it is yours to choose; change it whenever the policy changes.
data.value: {0} 上有一条 v=STSv1 记录处于生效状态，id 为 {1}。该 id 与建议值不同没有关系 - 它由您自己决定；每当策略变更时更改它即可。

data.name: A v=TLSRPTv1 record is live at {0} and its reports go to {1}.
data.value: {0} 上有一条 v=TLSRPTv1 记录处于生效状态，其报告发送至 {1}。

data.name: A v=TLSRPTv1 record is live at {0} with rua={1} - a different report mailbox than the one above, which is fine as long as it exists and is read. Published: {2}
data.value: {0} 上有一条 v=TLSRPTv1 记录处于生效状态，rua={1} - 与上面的报告邮箱不同，只要它确实存在并且有人查看，这就没有问题。发布时间：{2}

data.name: A valid ARC chain (RFC 8617) from a sealer named below cancels the DMARC failure score of a message that forwarding broke, and never more than that score. It needs 'Evaluate DMARC policies' above to be on.
data.value: 来自下方所列密封者的有效 ARC 链（RFC 8617）会抵消因转发而失败的邮件的 DMARC 失败分数，且绝不超过该分数。它需要打开上面的“评估 DMARC 策略”。

data.name: A value this account holds of its own wins over its domain's and the server's. Tick a setting to give the account a value of its own, untick it to take its domain's, and save the levels: they are written at once, not with the dialog's Save.
data.value: 此账户自己的值优先于其域和服务器的值。勾选一项设置可为账户指定自己的值，取消勾选则采用其域的值，然后保存级别：它们会立即写入，而不是随对话框的保存一起写入。

data.name: A value this domain holds of its own wins over the server's for every account of it that holds none. Tick a setting to give the domain a value of its own, untick it to take the server's, and save the levels: they are written at once, not with the dialog's Save. A setting kept in a field of its own is edited on that field's tab and shown here with what is in effect.
data.value: 对于没有自己值的每个账户，此域自己的值优先于服务器的值。勾选一项设置可为域指定自己的值，取消勾选则采用服务器的值，然后保存级别：它们会立即写入，而不是随对话框的保存一起写入。保存在专用字段中的设置在该字段的选项卡上编辑，此处显示其生效值。

data.name: A version older than 6.2.17; upgrade, because that is the version that added these lines.
data.value: 早于 6.2.17 的版本；请升级，因为正是该版本添加了这些行。

data.name: A virus scanner that stops responding. ClamAV is contacted after the message is accepted, so a wedged clamd shows up as accepted-but-never-delivered. Each socket operation is bounded by the ClamAV minimum and maximum timeouts on the Anti-virus settings page - a deadline on one read or write, armed afresh each time, so a large message streamed in chunks can take longer than the maximum timeout in total.
data.value: 停止响应的病毒扫描器。ClamAV 是在邮件被接受之后才联系的，因此卡死的 clamd 表现为“已接受但始终未投递”。每一次套接字操作都受“反病毒设置”页上 ClamAV 的最小超时和最大超时限定 - 那是对单次读或写的期限，每次重新计时，因此分块传输的大邮件总耗时可能超过最大超时。

data.name: A way back from a profile is held and cannot be read, so it cannot be put back. Discard it to apply a profile; the audit trail names each value the profile replaced.
data.value: 已保留某个配置方案的恢复记录，但无法读取，因此无法恢复。请放弃它以应用配置方案；审计记录列出了该方案替换的每个值。

data.name: ACL (shared folder permissions)
data.value: ACL（共享文件夹权限）

data.name: ACME (Let's Encrypt)
data.value: ACME（Let's Encrypt）

data.name: ACME certificates - the CA must reach this server from the internet
data.value: ACME 证书 - CA 必须能够从互联网访问本服务器

data.name: ACME directory URL
data.value: ACME 目录 URL

data.name: ACME is off (the default), so nothing external is required.
data.value: ACME 已关闭（默认值），因此不需要任何外部条件。

data.name: ACME is on and 'Reuse the private key across renewals' is off, so every certificate renewal generates a new private key. If you publish '3 1 1' TLSA records they will break on the next renewal - turn it on again on the Certificates (ACME) page (the default), or update the TLSA record after every renewal.
data.value: 已启用 ACME，但“在续订之间重用同一把私钥”处于关闭状态，因此每次续期证书都会生成新的私钥。如果您发布 '3 1 1' 的 TLSA 记录，它们会在下一次续期时失效 - 请在“证书（ACME）”页上重新打开它（默认值），或者在每次续期之后更新 TLSA 记录。

data.name: ACME is on, but 'Host names for the certificate' on the Certificates (ACME) page is empty, so no certificate is ever requested - the client logs 'No domains configured' and stops. List there the host names the certificate should cover (for example mail.yourdomain.com, mta-sts.yourdomain.com).
data.value: 已启用 ACME，但“证书（ACME）”页上的“证书的主机名”为空，因此永远不会请求证书 - 客户端会记录“No domains configured”并停止。请在那里列出证书应涵盖的主机名（例如 mail.yourdomain.com、mta-sts.yourdomain.com）。

data.name: ACME is switched on but no certificate has been issued yet - fullchain.pem and privkey.pem are not both in {0}. Issue happens on the server's own schedule, so this is normal for a few minutes after enabling it; if it persists, the CA could not reach this server, and the Setup checklist page checks exactly that.
data.value: ACME 已打开，但尚未颁发任何证书 - fullchain.pem 和 privkey.pem 并未同时位于 {0} 中。颁发按服务器自己的计划进行，因此启用后的几分钟内出现这种情况是正常的；如果一直如此，说明 CA 无法访问到本服务器，而“设置清单”页检查的正是这一点。

data.name: AD do_main of that user
data.value: 该用户的 AD 域(_M)

data.name: API & monitoring
data.value: API 与监控

data.name: API keys
data.value: API 密钥

data.name: ARC filtering is ENABLED but the trusted-sealer list is EMPTY, so it does nothing at all. That is deliberate, not a bug: anyone can fabricate a whole ARC chain and seal it with a key they publish in their own DNS, and it will validate perfectly - so a passing chain proves nothing unless you already trust the sealer. The list is not an option of the feature, it is the feature.
data.value: ARC 过滤已启用，但受信任签封方的列表为空，因此它完全不起作用。这是有意为之，不是缺陷：任何人都可以伪造一整条 ARC 链，并用自己在其 DNS 中发布的密钥签封，而它会完美通过验证 - 因此除非您本来就信任该签封方，否则通过验证的链什么也证明不了。这份列表不是该功能的一个选项，它就是该功能本身。

data.name: ARC filtering is enabled and trusts: {0}. Seals from any other domain are ignored, and matching is exact - a subdomain or a lookalike of a trusted name is not trusted.
data.value: ARC 过滤已启用，信任：{0}。来自其他任何域的签封都会被忽略，而且匹配是精确的 - 受信任名称的子域或形似名称都不受信任。

data.name: ARC filtering is off, so forwarded mail that fails DMARC is scored as it arrives. That is the default and it is a reasonable choice; turn it on only once you have forwarders whose seals you are willing to trust.
data.value: ARC 过滤已关闭，因此未通过 DMARC 的转发邮件会按到达时的情况计分。这是默认值，也是合理的选择；只有当您有了愿意信任其签封的转发方之后，再打开它。

data.name: ARC inbound filtering
data.value: ARC 入站过滤

data.name: ARC inbound filtering - name the forwarders you trust
data.value: ARC 入站过滤 - 指明您信任的转发方

data.name: ARC sealing
data.value: ARC 签封

data.name: ARC sealing is off (the default), so nothing external is required.
data.value: ARC 签封已关闭（默认值），因此不需要任何外部条件。

data.name: ARC sealing is on and at least one active domain has a DKIM selector and key to seal with. The DNS side is covered by the DKIM item above - the seal verifies against the same TXT record.
data.value: ARC 签封已打开，并且至少有一个活动的域具备可用于签封的 DKIM 选择器和密钥。DNS 方面已由上面的 DKIM 项涵盖 - 签封是针对同一条 TXT 记录验证的。

data.name: ARC sealing is on, but no active domain has DKIM signing with a selector and key file configured, so forwarded mail is silently not sealed at all.
data.value: ARC 签封已打开，但没有任何活动的域配置了带选择器和密钥文件的 DKIM 签名，因此转发邮件根本不会被签封，而且不会有任何提示。

data.name: ARC sealing of forwarded mail - needs a domain DKIM key

data.name: Applied when a password is CHOSEN - here, in the account editor, by a script or by the API - and never when one is checked at logon. That distinction is the whole design: an account whose password predates the policy keeps working, because locking people out of mailboxes they can open today is a worse outcome than the weak password it would be correcting. Tightening these settings therefore affects the next password each person sets, not the one they have. Everything is off until you turn it on, so an upgrade never starts refusing passwords on its own.

data.name: Between the 354 and the 250 the server runs the accept pipeline - spam tests, message modifications, archiving, the OnAcceptMessage script and the database save - on a bounded pool of threads, and replies only when it finishes. The log times each stage. Read it as a sequence and look for the last line written: the stage that is stuck is the one after it. Two stages announce themselves with a start line (spam-protection and script/save); message modifications do not, so a stall there shows as "done spam-protection" followed by silence. A stage taking ten seconds or more is logged at application level even without debug logging.
data.value: 在 354 和 250 之间，服务器会在一个有上限的线程池上运行接受管道 - 垃圾邮件测试、邮件修改、存档、OnAcceptMessage 脚本和数据库保存 - 并且只在完成后才应答。日志会记录每个阶段的耗时。请把它当作一个序列来读，找出最后写入的那一行：卡住的阶段就是它之后的那个。有两个阶段会用一行开始行宣告自己（spam-protection 和 script/save）；邮件修改则不会，因此该处的停滞表现为 "done spam-protection" 之后便没有下文。任何耗时十秒或更久的阶段都会在应用程序级别记录，即使没有开启调试日志。

data.name: Biased upwards on purpose: refusing early costs delivery latency and nothing else, because the refusal is temporary and a sending server retries for days, while a volume that reaches zero costs a database that will not open and a service that will not start.
data.value: 有意偏高：提前拒绝只会付出投递延迟的代价，别无其他，因为拒绝是临时性的，发送服务器会重试数天；而卷空间降到零的代价则是数据库打不开、服务无法启动。

data.name: Both overrides read the score this server recorded in the message, so they need 'Add X-hMailServer-Reason header' switched on, on the Anti-spam settings page. With it off no score is recorded, nothing is provable, and neither override acts - the account keeps the server-wide behaviour. The value in the file is not trusted in that case because nothing stops a SENDER putting one there.

data.name: Both thresholds are 0, so no score can mark or refuse anything - the server tests them with "greater than 0" before using them. It also stops testing as soon as the running total reaches the higher threshold, which is 0, so exactly one check runs in each phase and its result is discarded.

data.name: Ceilings on a single IMAP SEARCH or SORT, measured from the start of the search, so that one client searching a very large mailbox cannot occupy a connection indefinitely. If users with big mailboxes report searches failing or returning nothing, these are the two to raise. Either half can be turned off on its own by setting it to 0.
data.value: 单次 IMAP SEARCH 或 SORT 的上限，从搜索开始时计算，以免一个客户端搜索超大邮箱时无限期占用一个连接。如果拥有大邮箱的用户报告搜索失败或没有返回结果，就应该调高这两个值。任何一半都可以单独设为 0 以关闭。

data.name: Ceilings on what one authenticated account may submit over a rolling period - the brake on a compromised account being used to spam. Counted per account at SMTP submission: messages and envelope recipients separately, and a message refused by the limit gets a temporary error so a real client retries later. Unlike the rest of this page these are re-read within a couple of seconds of a change - saving here applies them without a service restart. Counters survive a restart via a state file in the data directory.
data.value: 一个已验证账户在一段滚动时间内可提交量的上限 - 是防止被盗账户被用来发垃圾邮件的刹车。在 SMTP 提交时按账户计数：邮件数和信封收件人数分别计数，被该限制拒绝的邮件会收到临时错误，因此真正的客户端稍后会重试。与本页的其他内容不同，这些设置会在更改后的几秒钟内重新读取 - 在此处保存后无需重启服务即可生效。计数器通过数据目录中的一个状态文件在重启后得以保留。

data.name: Certificate and key must BOTH be set to serve HTTPS; with only one of them TLS is NOT enabled and the server logs it. Unlike the REST API listener there is no fall-back to the ACME certificate here. If TLS is configured but cannot be prepared (an unreadable file, a key that does not match), the health probes stay on plain HTTP and /metrics answers 503 rather than serving the exposition in the clear.
data.value: 要提供 HTTPS，证书和密钥必须同时设置；只设置其中之一时不会启用 TLS，服务器会记录这一点。与 REST API 监听器不同，此处不会回退到 ACME 证书。如果配置了 TLS 但无法准备就绪（文件不可读、密钥不匹配），健康探测将保持在纯 HTTP 上，而 /metrics 会应答 503，而不是以明文提供指标输出。

data.name: Certificates are not verified on the connections this server makes when delivering. That is the normal setting for mail between servers - most of the internet's SMTP certificates would fail verification and the mail would stop - but it does mean outbound TLS protects against a passive listener only, not against something in the path. DANE and MTA-STS are how a specific destination gets more than that.

data.name: Changes what happens at the delete threshold. Off, a message over it is refused during the SMTP conversation with a 550 and the sender is told. On, it is accepted with a 250 and held for review instead - the sender believes it was delivered and will not retry, which is what makes a false positive recoverable without bouncing to a return path that is probably forged, and also means the review queue becomes the only place that message exists. Applies to checks that run after the message body has been received; a verdict reached before that (a connecting IP on a DNS block list, a bad HELO) has no message to hold and stays a refusal.
data.value: 更改在删除阈值处发生的事情。关闭时，超过该阈值的邮件会在 SMTP 会话期间以 550 拒绝，并告知发件方。打开时，它会以 250 接受并转为暂挂等待审核 - 发件方以为已投递而不会重试，正因如此，误判才能在不退信到一个很可能伪造的返回路径的情况下得以挽回，但这也意味着审核队列成为该邮件唯一存在的地方。适用于在邮件正文接收完毕之后运行的检查；在此之前得出的判定（连接 IP 被列入 DNS 拦截列表、HELO 不正确）没有邮件可暂挂，仍然是拒绝。

data.name: Checks a new password against the published breach corpus when it is chosen - here, in the account editor, in the webmail, by a script or over the REST API - and refuses one that has appeared in it. Only the first five characters of the password's SHA-1 hash leave this server; the endpoint answers with every hash that begins with them, padded so that the size of the answer says nothing either, and the comparison is made here. It is never applied at logon, so a password that works today keeps working. Off by default, because it sends something off the server.
data.value: 在设置新密码时（无论是在这里、在账户编辑器、在网页邮箱、通过脚本还是通过 REST API），将其与公开的泄露密码语料库比对，并拒绝其中出现过的密码。离开本服务器的只有密码 SHA-1 哈希的前五个字符；端点会返回所有以这五个字符开头的哈希，并加以填充，使响应的大小也不透露任何信息，比对在本服务器上进行。登录时从不应用此检查，因此今天能用的密码会继续可用。默认关闭，因为它会向服务器外部发送内容。

data.name: Chooses the envelope hMailServer puts around the secrets it stores for its own use: machine-scoped Windows DPAPI, which cannot be decrypted on any other machine, or the legacy Blowfish scheme, which can. Leave it on. It does not affect backup and restore - nothing in a backup archive is DPAPI-protected, and a restore re-protects each secret under the destination machine's own setting - so a backup taken here restores onto another machine with this switched on.
data.value: 选择 hMailServer 包裹其自用机密的封套：机器范围的 Windows DPAPI（无法在任何其他机器上解密），或者旧式的 Blowfish 方案（可以）。请保持打开。它不影响备份和还原 - 备份存档中没有任何内容受 DPAPI 保护，而还原时会按目标机器自己的设置重新保护每个机密 - 因此在此处打开该开关时做的备份可以还原到另一台机器上。

data.name: Count a full mailbox as a hard bounce
data.value: 将邮箱已满计为硬退信

data.name: Counted logon failures cleared. Addresses already banned stay banned until their "Auto-ban:" range expires - delete it on the IP ranges page to release one now.
data.value: 已清除计数的登录失败。已被封禁的地址在其“Auto-ban:”范围过期之前仍保持封禁 - 要立即解除某一个，请在“IP 范围”页删除它。

data.name: Counted per account from the last login that was allowed, so a refused attempt does not push the next one further away. It is advertised only while it is set, because announcing a limit that is not enforced is worse than announcing nothing.
data.value: 按账户从上一次被允许的登录起计数，因此被拒绝的尝试不会把下一次推得更远。只在设置了该值时才会通告，因为宣布一个并不强制执行的限制比什么都不宣布更糟。

data.name: Counted per connecting IP address across every protocol that authenticates - SMTP AUTH, POP3, IMAP, ManageSieve and the REST API all feed the same counter. On reaching the limit the server clears that address's counted failures and creates an IP range named "Auto-ban: <user>" at priority 100 covering that one address, which expires on its own.
data.value: 按连接的 IP 地址计数，覆盖所有进行身份验证的协议 - SMTP AUTH、POP3、IMAP、ManageSieve 和 REST API 全都汇入同一个计数器。达到限制时，服务器会清除该地址已计数的失败，并创建一个名为“Auto-ban: <user>”、优先级为 100、仅覆盖该地址的 IP 范围，它会自行过期。

data.name: Counted per user name rather than per address, across every protocol that authenticates, so a botnet spreading its guesses over thousands of addresses still locks the mailbox it is guessing at. A locked name is refused with the ordinary invalid-credentials reply and cannot be unlocked by typing the right password - the lock is checked first - so the ceiling is worth setting with the cost in mind. Failures against a name that does not exist lock that name too, deliberately: doing otherwise would let an attacker use the lockout to discover which accounts are real.
data.value: 按用户名而不是按地址计数，覆盖所有进行身份验证的协议，因此把猜测分散到数千个地址上的僵尸网络仍然会锁住它所猜测的那个邮箱。被锁定的用户名会以普通的凭据无效应答拒绝，而且无法通过输入正确密码来解锁 - 锁定会先被检查 - 因此设置此上限时值得权衡代价。针对不存在的用户名的失败同样会锁定该用户名，这是有意的：否则攻击者就能利用锁定来发现哪些账户是真实存在的。

data.name: Each IMAP folder keeps a counter for the next message UID it will issue. If that counter falls behind the messages already in the folder - which a restored or hand-edited database can do - the folder issues a UID it has already used, and a client that caches by UID shows one message where another should be. This moves every counter up to the highest UID its folder actually holds. It never moves one down, so it cannot cause the fault it repairs.
data.value: 每个 IMAP 文件夹都保存一个计数器，记录它将要签发的下一个邮件 UID。如果该计数器落后于文件夹中已有的邮件 - 还原过或手工编辑过的数据库可能造成这种情况 - 文件夹就会签发一个已经用过的 UID，而按 UID 缓存的客户端会在本该显示某封邮件的位置显示另一封。此操作会把每个计数器上调到其文件夹实际持有的最高 UID。它永远不会把计数器下调，因此不可能造成它所修复的这种故障。

data.name: Each accepted inbound message gets one Authentication-Results header (RFC 8601) carrying the SPF, DKIM and DMARC verdicts this server reached about it. Only checks that actually ran are reported - which checks run is configured on the Anti-spam settings page - and a message on which no check ran gets no header. An arriving message that already carries an Authentication-Results header claiming this server's own identity has that header removed first, so a sender cannot have a verdict written in this server's name believed downstream (RFC 8601 section 5).
data.value: 每一封被接受的入站邮件都会获得一个 Authentication-Results 标头（RFC 8601），其中带有本服务器对它得出的 SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC 判定。只报告实际运行过的检查 - 运行哪些检查在“反垃圾邮件设置”页配置 - 而没有运行任何检查的邮件不会获得该标头。到达的邮件如果已经带有声称是本服务器身份的 Authentication-Results 标头，会先被移除该标头，这样发件人就无法以本服务器的名义写入一个让下游相信的判定（RFC 8601 第 5 节）。

data.name: Each as [ipv4:|ipv6:]zone[=codes], separated by commas or spaces, such as ipv4:zen.spamhaus.org. By default four lists, asked for IPv4: Spamhaus ZEN, SpamCop, PSBL and Mailspike.
data.value: 每项的格式为 [ipv4:|ipv6:]zone[=codes]，用逗号或空格分隔，例如 ipv4:zen.spamhaus.org。默认是对 IPv4 查询的四个列表：Spamhaus ZEN、SpamCop、PSBL 和 Mailspike。

data.name: Each as the browser writes it: https, the host and any port. Empty, the default, is right while the relying party is empty; once a relying party is set, no passkey is registered or taken until this names the origins.

data.name: Each cached session costs server memory, and a client that churns handshakes grows the cache - this cap is the defence. A positive value replaces OpenSSL's default cap of 20480 sessions. -1 turns the server-side cache off entirely, which stops session-ID resumption but leaves tickets - which cost the server no memory - unaffected. 0 leaves OpenSSL alone.
data.value: 每个缓存的会话都要占用服务器内存，而频繁重复握手的客户端会让缓存增长 - 此上限就是防线。正值会替换 OpenSSL 默认的 20480 个会话的上限。-1 会完全关闭服务器端缓存，这会停止会话 ID 恢复，但票证（不占用服务器内存）不受影响。0 则不干预 OpenSSL。

data.name: Each check can be enabled separately and given its own score.
data.value: 每项检查都可以单独启用，并赋予各自的分数。

data.name: Each message
data.value: 每封邮件

data.name: Each message is scanned twice over: once as the whole file on disk, and then once per attachment, each written out to the temporary folder and handed to the scanner on its own. The second pass is what catches an attachment inside a structure the scanner does not decode for itself. If the message cannot be parsed as MIME the per-attachment pass is skipped and an error is logged.
data.value: 每封邮件会被扫描两遍：先把磁盘上的整个文件扫描一次，然后按附件逐个扫描，每个附件都写出到临时文件夹并单独交给扫描器。第二遍能抓住扫描器自己不解码的结构中所包含的附件。如果邮件无法解析为 MIME，则跳过逐附件扫描并记录一条错误。

data.name: Each profile sets the settings one kind of server needs. Showing one lists every setting beside the value this server holds now; nothing changes until it is applied.

data.name: Each retry before the initial delay has passed starts the delay again from that moment, so a sender that retries on a timer rather than from a queue never reaches the window. Off by default: a well-behaved server that retries once too quickly is delayed a little longer with it on.
data.value: 初始延迟结束前的每次重试都会从那一刻起重新开始延迟，因此按定时器而非从队列重试的发件人永远到不了窗口。默认关闭：开启后，偶尔一次重试过快的守规矩的服务器会被多延迟一会儿。

data.name: Each spam check in the order the server runs it, what it adds to the score, and what the total does to a message. Nothing here can be edited: each row's link opens the page that owns its setting.

data.name: Empties the index and asks the indexer to rebuild it. No mail is touched - the index is derived data - but until the rebuild catches up, IMAP SEARCH finds less than it should. Worth doing when the index has more entries than the server has messages, which means entries for mail that no longer exists.

data.name: Empty means nobody, which is the safe default. Matched against the real TCP peer. An entry that does not parse matches nothing rather than everything, and is reported in the error log once per run.
data.value: 留空表示无人，这是安全的默认值。与真实的 TCP 对端进行匹配。无法解析的条目不会匹配任何东西，而不是匹配所有东西，并且每次运行会在错误日志中报告一次。

data.name: Empty means nobody. XCLIENT is not even advertised in EHLO to an upstream that is not listed here, so an attacker learns nothing about the deployment by asking.
data.value: 留空表示无人。对于未列在此处的上游，甚至不会在 EHLO 中通告 XCLIENT，因此攻击者无法通过询问来了解部署情况。

data.name: Empty means postmaster at this server's host name.
data.value: 空表示本服务器主机名上的 postmaster。

data.name: Empty means the systemd journal on Linux, and means nothing is sent on Windows. A collector that stops answering never delays mail: entries queue, the oldest are dropped once 4096 are waiting, and the application log says so once when it starts and once when the collector comes back.
data.value: 留空在 Linux 上表示 systemd journal，在 Windows 上表示不发送任何内容。停止应答的收集器绝不会延误邮件：条目进入队列，待发条目达到 4096 条后丢弃最旧的，应用程序日志会在开始时记录一次、在收集器恢复时再记录一次。

data.name: Envelope domains and HELO suffixes let past greylisting when the message carries the authentication results the entry requires - SPF, DKIM, DMARC, any combination. A domain matched exactly, or a suffix with a leading dot such as .mail.example.com covering that name and every name under it. SPF is known at RCPT TO, so an entry requiring SPF alone decides there; DKIM and DMARC exist only after the message is in, so an entry requiring either lets the recipient through for now and the message is greylisted after DATA if the result is not a pass - and only while DKIM verification or DMARC is switched on, since otherwise the entry can never be satisfied. Unlike Bypass on SPF success, this is a privilege you grant to a named domain rather than a property of every SPF pass in the world.
data.value: 当邮件带有条目要求的认证结果（SPF、DKIM、DMARC 的任意组合）时放行灰名单的信封域名和 HELO 后缀。精确匹配的域名，或以点开头的后缀如 .mail.example.com（覆盖该名称及其下的所有名称）。SPF 在 RCPT TO 时即可得知，因此仅要求 SPF 的条目在该处决定；DKIM 和 DMARC 只有在邮件收到后才存在，因此要求其中之一的条目暂时放行收件人，若结果不是通过，邮件在 DATA 之后进入灰名单，并且仅在 DKIM 验证或 DMARC 开启时如此，否则该条目永远无法满足。与 SPF 通过时绕过不同，这是您授予指定域名的特权，而不是世界上每一次 SPF 通过都具有的属性。

data.name: Envelope senders refused outright, or scored. An entry with an @ is one exact address; without one it is a whole domain including its subdomains. The default score of 100 crosses the delete threshold and refuses the message during the SMTP conversation. This matches the address the sender CLAIMS, so it stops a correspondent who keeps using one address - it is not an anti-spoofing tool, and stops nothing that rotates addresses.

data.name: Every counter the metrics endpoint exposes is server-wide, which is what stops metrics becoming reporting: you can see how much mail the server handled, never how much any one domain did. This adds a count of messages sent and received per hosted domain. Off by default, and that is a cardinality decision rather than a cautious one - every label value is a separate time series in whatever scrapes this, so an operator hosting several thousand domains should choose to pay for that rather than find out. Only domains this server hosts are ever labelled, so no amount of mail from strangers can create series.

data.name: Forwarding a message keeps the original envelope sender, so the next hop checks SPF for a domain that never authorised this server and the message fails. These are the two answers. SRS rewrites the envelope sender into one this server can vouch for and can undo on the way back, so bounces still reach the original sender; BATV tags the envelope sender of outbound mail so a forged bounce - one for a message this server never sent - can be told apart from a real one. Both use a server-wide secret and do nothing at all until one is set.
data.value: 转发邮件会保留原始的信封发件人，因此下一跳会针对一个从未授权本服务器的域检查 SPF，邮件就会失败。这里是两种解决办法。SRS 把信封发件人改写成本服务器能够担保、并能在返回时还原的地址，这样退信仍能到达原始发件人；BATV 给出站邮件的信封发件人加上标记，这样伪造的退信 - 针对本服务器从未发送过的邮件的退信 - 就能与真实退信区分开。两者都使用一个服务器范围的机密，在设置机密之前什么都不做。

data.name: Hands every accepted message to an engine over HTTP and uses the score it returns. data.name: Holds the refusal of a wrong password for a while before sending it: the first failure on a connection waits this many seconds, the second twice as long, and so on up to 30 seconds, on SMTP, POP3 and IMAP alike. A correct password is never delayed. The wait is a timer on the connection, not a thread asleep, so a flood of failed logons costs the server nothing but the sockets they arrive on.
data.value: 在发送错误密码的拒绝应答之前先等待一段时间：连接上的第一次失败等待这么多秒，第二次等待两倍时间，依此类推，最多 30 秒，SMTP、POP3 和 IMAP 一视同仁。正确的密码永远不会被延迟。这个等待是连接上的定时器，而不是休眠的线程，因此大量失败登录除了它们所到达的套接字之外不会给服务器带来任何开销。

data.name: How long a connection may sit idle before it is closed, per protocol, in seconds. "Server" is hMailServer accepting a connection from a mail client or another mail server; "client" is hMailServer connecting out to deliver mail or to fetch it from an external POP3 account. The effective timeout moves between the minimum and the maximum with server load, so a busy server drops idle connections sooner.
data.value: 连接在被关闭之前可以空闲多久，按协议划分，以秒计。“服务器”指 hMailServer 接受来自邮件客户端或另一台邮件服务器的连接；“客户端”指 hMailServer 向外连接以投递邮件或从外部 POP3 账户收取邮件。实际超时会随服务器负载在最小值和最大值之间变动，因此繁忙的服务器会更早断开空闲连接。

data.name: How long a counted failure is kept, rather than a sliding window: a housekeeping pass running once a minute deletes failure records older than this - and only while auto-ban is enabled.

data.name: How long a session stays resumable, for cached sessions and tickets alike. It bounds how long a leaked resumption secret stays useful: a ticket recorded off the wire, or a session read out of a memory dump, stops working once it expires.
data.value: 会话保持可恢复的时长，对缓存的会话和票证都适用。它限定了泄露的恢复机密能用多久：从线路上记录下来的票证，或从内存转储中读出的会话，一旦过期就不再起作用。

data.name:
Install the update now?
The verified installer is handed to the update helper: the service stops, the new version is installed, and the service starts again. If it does not come back, the previous version is reinstalled, unless the new version has already changed the database. This Control Panel loses its connection while that happens; reconnect afterwards to see the outcome here.
data.value:
是否立即安装更新？
已验证的安装程序将交给更新助手：服务停止，安装新版本，然后服务重新启动。如果它没有恢复，则重新安装先前的版本（除非新版本已更改了数据库）。在此期间，此控制面板会失去连接；之后请重新连接，以便在此处查看结果。

data.name: It governs two kinds of stored secret. Those bound to this machine - the database password in hMailServer.INI, the SMTP relayer password, and the passwords, tokens and passphrases of routes, external fetch accounts, SSL certificates and the rest kept in the database - are put in a Windows DPAPI envelope when they are next saved, or in the legacy Blowfish scheme while this is switched off. The secrets in the [Settings] section - the SRS and BATV secrets, the OAuth2 secrets, the metrics bearer token and HTTP Basic password, the Windows service account password and the GSSAPI service password - and each account's second factor are sealed under the installation's stored-secrets key once it has one, at the next start and at every save; switched off, the next start stores them as written again. Only the password pepper is always stored as you typed it, so hMailServer.INI should still be readable only by Administrators and by the account the service runs as.
data.value: 它管理两类存储的机密。绑定到这台计算机的机密 - hMailServer.INI 中的数据库密码、SMTP 中继服务器密码，以及路由、外部收取账户、SSL 证书和数据库中其余内容的密码、令牌和密码短语 - 在下次保存时放入 Windows DPAPI 封装，关闭此项时则使用旧的 Blowfish 方案。[Settings] 部分中的机密 - SRS 和 BATV 机密、OAuth2 机密、指标持有者令牌和 HTTP Basic 密码、Windows 服务账户密码以及 GSSAPI 服务密码 - 和每个账户的第二因素，在安装拥有存储机密密钥后，于下次启动时和每次保存时用该密钥密封；关闭此项后，下次启动会再次按原样存储它们。只有密码 pepper 始终按您输入的原样存储，因此 hMailServer.INI 仍应只允许 Administrators 和服务运行所用的账户读取。

data.name: Live, from the running server. The hit rate is the share of lookups answered from memory since the counters last reset - which they do when the service restarts, when a cache is switched off, and when its TTL is changed, so a rate right after any of those describes a very short sample. A lookup for something that does not exist counts as a miss and caches nothing, so a server being probed for addresses it does not host shows a low rate without anything being wrong with the cache.

data.name: Look for "Task SMTP-accept session=42 ip=... waited 8 seconds for a thread in work queue Asynchronous task queue" and, when it is severe, "All 15 threads in work queue Asynchronous task queue have been busy for at least 120 seconds, so no further task on this queue can start". That means every worker is occupied and messages are queuing behind them: one slow dependency does this to the whole server, which is why a single wedged scanner used to look like the server had stopped responding. The task names say which sessions are stuck; the stage timings say what they are stuck on.

data.name: MAIL FROM:<> is the reverse-path of a delivery report, and a report has exactly one recipient: the address that sent the message it is about. A null sender that goes on to name a second recipient is backscatter, a forged report or a probe. Off, the server accepts it as it always has. On, the second and every later RCPT TO is answered 550 and the transaction's DATA is refused as well; a null sender with one recipient is never touched. Unauthenticated sessions of an IP range that runs the spam tests only, and never a sender in the spam exemptions. To allow or block a domain outright, use the Allowed and blocked domains page, under Spam & virus filtering.
data.value: MAIL FROM:<> 是投递报告的回传路径，而报告只有一个收件人：发送该报告所涉邮件的地址。空发件人随后又指定第二个收件人，就是反向散射、伪造的报告或探测。关闭时，服务器像以往一样接受它。开启时，第二个及之后的每个 RCPT TO 都回应 550，该事务的 DATA 也被拒绝；只有一个收件人的空发件人从不受影响。仅适用于运行反垃圾邮件测试的 IP 范围内的未认证会话，绝不适用于反垃圾邮件豁免中的发件人。要整体允许或拦截某个域，请使用“垃圾邮件和病毒过滤”下的“允许与拦截的域”页。

data.name: Moving a message into the folder designated Junk reports it to sa-learn as spam, and moving one back out reports it as ham, so the filter learns from what people already do rather than from a separate ritual nobody performs. Off by default: it runs sa-learn per move, and a user who files newsletters in Junk is teaching the filter that newsletters are spam for everyone the scanner serves.
data.value: 把邮件移入指定为 Junk 的文件夹，会向 sa-learn 报告它是垃圾邮件；把邮件再移出来，则报告它是正常邮件。这样过滤器就能从人们本来就在做的事情中学习，而不是从一套没人会执行的单独仪式中学习。默认关闭：它每移动一次就运行一次 sa-learn，而一个把新闻邮件归入 Junk 的用户，是在教过滤器：对该扫描器所服务的所有人来说，新闻邮件都是垃圾邮件。

data.name: NCSA Common Log Format writes one line per entry as host, ident, session, [date], "category and message", status, bytes - so a log analyser can count 5xx replies without knowing anything about hMailServer. Ident and bytes are always "-" (the server never queries identd and the logger is not told transfer sizes), and the AWStats journal is a separate file that this setting does not change: its own switch is above.
data.value: NCSA 通用日志格式每个条目写一行，格式为 host、ident、session、[date]、"category and message"、status、bytes - 这样日志分析器无需了解 hMailServer 的任何知识就能统计 5xx 应答。ident 和 bytes 始终为 "-"（服务器从不查询 identd，日志记录器也不知道传输大小），而 AWStats 日志是一个独立的文件，此设置不会改变它：它自己的开关在上面。

data.name: Off by default because it costs a term table of a few kilobytes per message and a backfill pass over every message already delivered - an administrator's decision, never an upgrade's. Results are identical on and off: the index only narrows which messages the substring scan has to read. Requires message indexing (above) to be enabled; on its own this indexes nothing.
data.value: 默认关闭，因为它的代价是每封邮件几千字节的词条表，以及对每封已投递邮件的一次回填遍历 - 这是管理员的决定，绝不是升级的决定。打开和关闭的结果完全相同：索引只是缩小了子串扫描必须读取的邮件范围。需要启用（上面的）邮件索引；单独打开此项不会索引任何内容。

data.name: Off by default, and inert when off: directory-linked accounts are then validated the old way, through Windows logon. When on, the same accounts - the ones with the Windows directory tab filled in - are validated by an LDAP bind against the server below instead. Non-directory accounts are never affected either way.
data.value: 默认关闭，关闭时不起作用：关联目录的账户此时按旧方式通过 Windows 登录验证。打开时，同样的这些账户 - 填写了“Windows 目录”选项卡的账户 - 改为通过对下面的服务器进行 LDAP 绑定来验证。非目录账户在任何情况下都不受影响。

data.name: Off by default.
data.value: 默认关闭。

data.name: Off by default. A phone moving between wi-fi and a mobile network loses its session while this is on.
data.value: 默认关闭。打开时，在 Wi-Fi 和移动网络之间切换的手机会丢失会话。

data.name: Off by default. A zero-access mailbox is encrypted to the person's own key: this server can no longer read, search, export or recover its mail, and a forgotten password without the recovery key loses it. Allowing it switches nobody on.
data.value: 默认关闭。零访问邮箱用本人的密钥加密：本服务器将无法再读取、搜索、导出或恢复其邮件，没有恢复密钥时忘记密码就会失去它。允许并不会为任何人打开它。

data.name: Off by default. An account that stops being visible in the directory is far more often a search that changed than a person who left, and the two mistakes do not cost the same. Nothing is disabled at all when the enumeration was cut short or came back empty.
data.value: 默认关闭。在目录中不再可见的账户，更常见的原因是搜索条件变了，而不是有人离职了，而这两种错误的代价并不相同。当枚举被中途截断或返回为空时，完全不会禁用任何账户。

data.name: Off by default. An account that stops being visible is far more often a filter that changed than a person who left, and the two mistakes do not cost the same. No message is ever deleted and no account is removed - re-enabling one restores everything.
data.value: 默认关闭。不再可见的账户，更常见的原因是过滤器变了，而不是有人离职了，而这两种错误的代价并不相同。永远不会删除任何邮件，也不会移除任何账户 - 重新启用一个账户即可恢复一切。

data.name: Off by default. Does nothing unless SpamAssassin is enabled and its spamd allows TELL.
data.value: 默认关闭。如果 SpamAssassin 未打开，或其 spamd 不允许 TELL，则不起作用。

data.name: Off by default. Its community crosses the network in the clear, so anyone who can see the traffic can read what the agent serves.
data.value: 默认关闭。其团体名以明文在网络上传输，任何能看到流量的人都能读取代理提供的内容。

data.name: Off by default. MAIL FROM:<> is no excuse: a delivery report from a server that greets with an address is refused like any other mail from it.
data.value: 默认关闭。MAIL FROM:<> 不是豁免理由：来自以地址问候的服务器的投递报告，会像它发来的其他邮件一样被拒绝。

data.name: Off by default. Only when the banned address's own reverse name resolves back to it; at most 32 addresses each way; never into another /24, across an address either never-ban list above spares, or across an IP range of yours that covers one address and not the other; never for IPv6, nor for a private, shared, loopback or link-local address, whose neighbours are your own network's machines. A reverse lookup that is not answered leaves the single address. A hosting net whose customers all carry one reverse domain is widened whole: list it above, or leave this off.
data.value: 默认关闭。仅当被封禁地址自身的反向名称能解析回该地址时才进行；每个方向最多 32 个地址；绝不进入另一个 /24，绝不越过上方任一列表豁免的地址，也绝不越过您设置的只覆盖其中一个地址的 IP 范围；绝不用于 IPv6，也绝不用于私有、共享、环回或链路本地地址（其相邻地址是您自己网络中的机器）。未得到应答的反向查询会保持单个地址不变。所有客户都使用同一反向域的托管网络会被整体扩展：请将其列入上方，或保持此项关闭。

data.name: Off by default. Served under /.well-known/openpgpkey by the web services listener; a domain and the account have to allow it too, in their dialogs.
data.value: 默认关闭。由 Web 服务监听器在 /.well-known/openpgpkey 下提供；域和账户也必须在各自的对话框中允许。

data.name: Off by default. Turning it on means the server starts storing mail it considers spam, so watch the retention window below.
data.value: 默认关闭。打开它意味着服务器开始存储它认为是垃圾邮件的邮件，因此请留意下面的保留窗口。

data.name: Off by default. Useful on shared machines.
data.value: 默认关闭。在共用计算机上很有用。

data.name: Off by default. When off, an unreachable directory refuses the logon and the server reports the real reason (throttled to once per minute per distinct problem) instead of retrying through Windows logon - which cannot succeed on a host that is not domain-joined, and whose failure would bury a precise diagnostic under an indistinguishable one. Turn on only on a domain-joined host that wants LDAP as its first choice. A password the directory REJECTED never falls back either way: retrying it would double every failed attempt and let one wrong password trigger a directory lockout policy.
data.value: 默认关闭。关闭时，无法访问的目录会拒绝登录，服务器报告真实原因（每个不同的问题每分钟最多一次），而不是通过 Windows 登录重试 - 那在未加入域的主机上不可能成功，而且其失败会把精确的诊断埋没在无法区分的诊断之下。只在希望把 LDAP 作为首选的已加入域的主机上打开。被目录拒绝的密码无论如何都不会回退：重试它会让每次失败尝试翻倍，并让一个错误密码触发目录锁定策略。

data.name: Off by default. With it off nothing is queued and no push service is reached.
data.value: 默认关闭。关闭时不会排队任何内容，也不会联系任何推送服务。

data.name: Off by default. With it off nothing is read, counted or written.
data.value: 默认关闭。关闭时不读取、不计数、也不写入任何内容。

data.name: Off by default. With unprotected LDAP and a simple bind, the server does NOT send the password and does NOT guess what you meant: it refuses the logon and reports the contradiction, once per minute. Turning this on sends passwords in the clear and should only ever happen on a network you control end to end.
data.value: 默认关闭。在未受保护的 LDAP 配合简单绑定时，服务器不会发送密码，也不会猜测您的本意：它会拒绝登录并每分钟报告一次这一矛盾。打开此项会以明文发送密码，只应在您端到端完全掌控的网络上进行。

data.name: Off by default. user@[192.0.2.7], user@localhost and user@co.uk are refused; MAIL FROM:<> has no domain and is not judged by this switch.
data.value: 默认关闭。user@[192.0.2.7]、user@localhost 和 user@co.uk 会被拒绝；MAIL FROM:<> 没有域，此开关不评判它。

data.name: Off by default: a full mailbox is usually emptied, and listing it would stop mail to somebody who reads it next week.
data.value: 默认关闭：已满的邮箱通常会被清空，将其列入会让下周才阅读邮件的人收不到邮件。

data.name: Off by default: a subject line is what a message is about. It travels only where this and the subscription both allow it, and only on message.received and message.quarantined.
data.value: 默认关闭：主题就是邮件的内容所在。只有此设置和订阅都允许时才携带，并且仅在 message.received 和 message.quarantined 中。

data.name: Off by default: an address this server does not know is refused. A mailbox made this way has no password of its own and is in a domain the server already has.
data.value: 默认关闭：本服务器不认识的地址会被拒绝。以这种方式创建的邮箱没有自己的密码，并且位于服务器上已有的域中。

data.name: Off by default: the keyserver learns who is about to write to whom.
data.value: 默认关闭：密钥服务器会知道谁将要写信给谁。

data.name: Off by default: the server connects from inside your network on the person's word. Turn it on to let people collect from an old mail server inside the network.
data.value: 默认关闭：服务器会按用户的指示从你的网络内部发起连接。打开后，用户可以从网络内的旧邮件服务器收取邮件。

data.name: Off, as RFC 8301 requires: a signature using rsa-sha1 is treated as invalid, because SHA-1 can be forged. On, such signatures verify again, and a domain set to sign with rsa-sha1 is not upgraded to rsa-sha256.
data.value: 按 RFC 8301 的要求关闭：使用 rsa-sha1 的签名被视为无效，因为 SHA-1 可以被伪造。打开后，这类签名会重新通过验证，配置为用 rsa-sha1 签名的域也不会被升级到 rsa-sha256。

data.name: Off, the default, an engine that stops answering lets spam through until somebody notices, which is the recoverable failure. On, it stops the mail instead, and a message deferred while nobody is watching eventually bounces.
data.value: 关闭（默认）时，停止应答的引擎会放垃圾邮件通过，直到有人注意到，这是可以挽回的失败。打开时，它会改为拦下邮件，而在无人看管时被推迟的邮件最终会被退回。

data.name: Off. Directory-linked accounts are validated through Windows logon (LogonUser), which only works when this host is joined to the domain - every failure there looks like a wrong password.
data.value: 关闭。关联目录的账户通过 Windows 登录（LogonUser）验证，这只有在本主机加入了域时才有效 - 那里的每一次失败看起来都像密码错误。

data.name: Off. No message is deferred on a first attempt.
data.value: 关闭。首次尝试时不会推迟任何邮件。

data.name: Off: record and judge nothing
data.value: 关闭：不记录也不评分

data.name: Offer OpenPGP in the webmail
data.value: 在网页邮箱中提供 OpenPGP

data.name: Offer passkeys
data.value: 提供通行密钥

data.name: Offi_ce
data.value: 办公地点 (_E)

data.name: On
data.value: 打开

data.name: On - offer AUTH and check the password
data.value: 打开 - 提供 AUTH 并检查密码

data.name: On by default, and inert until somebody sets a recovery address.
data.value: 默认打开，在有人设置恢复地址之前不起作用。

data.name: On by default, and only an explicit 0 in the INI turns it off. Turned off, the encrypted connection no longer proves it reaches YOUR directory: anyone who can intercept it can present any certificate and collect every password sent over it. The server notes the disabling in its application log once per service start. Only meaningful for LDAPS and StartTLS.
data.value: 默认打开，只有 INI 中明确的 0 才会关闭它。关闭后，加密连接不再能证明它到达的是您的目录：任何能截获它的人都可以出示任意证书并收集经由它发送的每一个密码。服务器每次服务启动时会在应用程序日志中记录一次此项已禁用。仅对 LDAPS 和 StartTLS 有意义。

data.name: On by default, and the one switch here whose default is not the cautious one. With it off, a message for a mailbox that is already over quota is accepted and then answered with a non-delivery report addressed to the envelope sender - which the traffic that fills mailboxes fastest has forged. That report then goes from this server to somebody who sent nothing, which is backscatter, and it is this server's reputation that pays for it. Refusing at RCPT TO with a temporary 452 instead leaves the message in the sending server's queue, so a legitimate sender's mail waits for the mailbox to be emptied and is eventually reported by the machine that knows who the sender really is.
data.value: 默认打开，是这里唯一一个默认值不是保守选项的开关。关闭它时，发给已超出配额的邮箱的邮件会先被接受，然后以一份寄给信封发件人的未送达报告作答 - 而最快填满邮箱的那类流量恰恰伪造了信封发件人。这份报告随后从本服务器发给一个什么都没发过的人，这就是反向散射，付出代价的是本服务器的声誉。改为在 RCPT TO 时以临时的 452 拒绝，则邮件留在发送服务器的队列中，合法发件人的邮件会等到邮箱被清空，并最终由知道发件人究竟是谁的那台机器来报告。

data.name: On by default, which is how Entra ID and ADFS sign. Off accepts a signature over the whole response.
data.value: 默认打开，Entra ID 和 ADFS 就是这样签名的。关闭时接受对整个响应的签名。

data.name: On by default.
data.value: 默认打开。

data.name: On by default. After the archive is written its message store is extracted to the temp folder through the same code a restore uses, held to exactly the files the backup staged, and every message row is checked for its file; the result is in the backup log. The store exists twice while it runs, so turn it off for a store the temp volume cannot hold.
data.value: 默认开启。存档写入之后，会通过还原所用的同一套代码把它的邮件存储解压到临时文件夹，严格限定为备份所暂存的那些文件，并逐条检查每一行邮件记录是否有对应的文件；结果记录在备份日志中。运行期间存储会同时存在两份，因此对于临时卷容纳不下的存储请关闭它。

data.name: On by default. Off leaves the keys people already have in the database untouched.
data.value: 默认打开。关闭时，用户在数据库中已有的密钥保持不变。

data.name: On by default. Off refuses every passkey sign-in; the passkeys already enrolled stay until their owners remove them.
data.value: 默认打开。关闭时拒绝所有通行密钥登录；已注册的密钥会保留，直到其所有者删除。

data.name: On by default. Off silences every receiver at once and keeps the subscriptions; inbound webhooks are not affected.
data.value: 默认打开。关闭时所有接收方一起静默，订阅保留；传入的 Webhook 不受影响。

data.name: On by default. Only for mail that passed DMARC from a domain whose policy is quarantine or reject, which needs Authentication-Results headers on inbound mail, on the Transport security page.
data.value: 默认打开。仅针对来自策略为 quarantine 或 reject 的域、且通过 DMARC 的邮件，这需要“传输安全”页面上为传入邮件添加的 Authentication-Results 标头。

data.name: On by default. Turn it off where one domain holds people who are not one organisation.
data.value: 默认打开。如果一个域中的人不属于同一个组织，请关闭。

data.name: On by default: title, department, telephone numbers and photo. Off leaves them to the administrator; a person can always take themselves out of the directory.
data.value: 默认打开：职务、部门、电话号码和照片。关闭时由管理员维护；本人随时可以把自己从通讯录中移除。

data.name: On in a new installation and off after an upgrade. With no address to check it looks nothing up.
data.value: 新安装时打开，升级后关闭。没有要检查的地址时不查询任何内容。

data.name: On other pages
data.value: 在其他页面上

data.name: On stop, wait up to N seconds for active sessions to finish (0 = stop immediately)
data.value: 停止时，最多等待 N 秒让活动会话完成（0 = 立即停止）

data.name: On the Administrative access page's Two-factor tab, enrol an authenticator app for the administrator password.
data.value: 在管理访问权限页面的双因素选项卡中，为管理员密码注册身份验证器应用。

data.name: On the Anti-spam settings page, list the sealing domains you trust (the mailing-list and forwarding services your users rely on) and turn on the ARC offset. Naming who you trust is a judgement only you can make, which is why there is no default.
data.value: 在“反垃圾邮件设置”页列出您信任的签封域（您的用户依赖的邮件列表和转发服务），并打开 ARC 抵消。指明信任谁是只有您才能作出的判断，这就是没有默认值的原因。

data.name: On the Backup & restore page, set the folder the backup is written to, on a disk other than the one the message store is on.
data.value: 在“备份与还原”页上设置备份写入的文件夹，放在与邮件存储不同的磁盘上。

data.name: On the Protocols page's SMTP tab, set Host name to this server's full DNS name, such as mail.example.com. Then ask whoever owns the server's public address for a PTR record naming it; the DNS records page shows what to ask for.
data.value: 在“协议”页面的 SMTP 选项卡上，把主机名设置为本服务器的完整 DNS 名称，例如 mail.example.com。然后请服务器公共地址的所有者添加一条指向该名称的 PTR 记录；DNS 记录页面会显示需要请求什么。

data.name: On the Server limits & expert settings page, card Windows service account: Move to NT SERVICE\hMailServer grants the service its folders - asking first about any folder or key file the configuration names outside them - and moves it; then restart the service. Running the installer again offers the same choice. An external database with Windows authentication needs a login for the account as well.
data.value: 在“服务器限制和专家设置”页面的“Windows 服务账户”卡片上：“切换到 NT SERVICE\hMailServer”会授予服务其文件夹（先询问配置在其外指定的每个文件夹或密钥文件）并切换服务；然后重新启动服务。再次运行安装程序也会提供相同的选择。使用 Windows 身份验证的外部数据库还需要为该账户建立登录名。

data.name: On the Setting profiles page, compare the four with this server and apply the one that fits; what it replaces is kept, so that it can be put back.
data.value: 在“配置方案列表”页面上将这四个方案与此服务器比较，并应用合适的一个；它所替换的值会被保留以便恢复。

data.name: On the TCP/IP ports page, give the submission port (587) STARTTLS with a certificate from the SSL certificates page, or add port 465 with implicit TLS.
data.value: 在TCP/IP 端口页面，为提交端口 (587) 设置 STARTTLS 并使用SSL 证书页面的证书，或添加使用隐式 TLS 的端口 465。

data.name: On the TCP/IP ports page, open the SMTP port 25 and set its SMTP authentication to Honeypot or Off, then reinitialise. Mail clients that still sign in on 25 are refused and banned from then on, so move them to 587 first.
data.value: 在“TCP/IP 端口”页面上打开 SMTP 端口 25，将其 SMTP 身份验证设为“蜜罐”或“关闭”，然后重新初始化。此后仍在端口 25 登录的邮件客户端会被拒绝并封禁，因此请先把它们改到 587。

data.name: On the server, from an elevated prompt in the Bin folder: hMailServer.exe --create-stored-secrets-key makes the key, and hMailServer.exe --export-stored-secrets-key FILE exports it. Keep the file with the database backups, stored apart from them.
data.value: 在服务器上，从 Bin 文件夹中以管理员身份运行的命令提示符：hMailServer.exe --create-stored-secrets-key 创建密钥，hMailServer.exe --export-stored-secrets-key FILE 将其导出。请将该文件与数据库备份一起保存，但要与备份分开存放。

data.name: On, a check that could not be completed is answered 451 4.4.3, so the sender tries again when DNS works, and the temperror score above is not used. Off, a temperror is accepted and scored; a sender from an allowed domain is never deferred.
data.value: 打开时，对无法完成的检查以 451 4.4.3 应答，让发件人在 DNS 恢复后再试，上面的 temperror 分数不再使用。关闭时，temperror 会被接受并计分；来自允许的域的发件人从不被延迟。

data.value: 已打开，但无法运行

data.name: On, no host
data.value: 打开，无主机

data.name: On, scores 0
data.value: 打开，得分 0

data.name: On. A sender/recipient/address triplet that has not been seen before is answered 451 "Please try again later." at RCPT TO, and accepted when it retries. It runs after the connection checks above and adds no score.
data.value: 打开。此前未见过的发件人/收件人/地址三元组在 RCPT TO 时会收到 451 "Please try again later." 应答，重试时则被接受。它在上面的连接检查之后运行，不加分数。

data.name: Once a day the server asks the DNS block lists below whether an address it sends from is listed, and raises the reputation.listed alert when one is. It checks the delivery bind address and the addresses the global rules bind; a server behind NAT has to be told its public address here, because nothing on the machine can find it.
data.value: 服务器每天一次向下面的 DNS 拦截列表查询其发送地址是否被列入，如果被列入就触发 reputation.listed 警报。它检查投递的绑定地址和全局规则绑定的地址；位于 NAT 后面的服务器必须在这里告知其公共地址，因为计算机上没有任何东西能找到它。

data.name: Once a minute the server writes one row per metric - sessions, messages processed, delivered, deferred and bounced, spam and viruses, authentication and TLS outcomes, missing message files - to hm_metricsamples, and keeps them this many days. It is what the dashboard's 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days views and GET /api/v1/metrics/history read. A week of minute-resolution history is about a hundred and forty thousand small rows. 0 turns the sampler off.
data.value: 服务器每分钟为每个指标写入一行 - 会话、已处理、已投递、已推迟和已退回的邮件、垃圾邮件和病毒、身份验证和 TLS 结果、缺失的邮件文件 - 写入 hm_metricsamples，并保留这么多天。仪表板的 24 小时、7 天和 30 天视图以及 GET /api/v1/metrics/history 读取的正是这些数据。一周的分钟级历史大约是十四万行小记录。0 会关闭采样器。

data.name: One address of this machine: 127.0.0.1 when the manager runs here, otherwise an address on a management network.
data.value: 本计算机的一个地址：管理站在本机运行时为 127.0.0.1，否则为管理网络上的地址。

data.name: One blocked-attachment pattern is configured but attachment blocking is switched off, so it is not applied.

Otherwise another program holds the port, the address does not exist on this machine, or a TLS port's certificate could not be loaded - the error log says which.

data.name: One event script invocation. 0 = no bound.
data.value: 单次事件脚本调用。0 = 不限制。

data.name: One line of up to 60 characters. The default, Sign in with SAML, is shown in each reader's language; anything else as written.

data.name: One list of the nine checks, which are on, and which of the two phases each one runs in.

data.name: One message to each account of this domain that has something newly held for it, listing what was held with a link that delivers it. A link works once and stops working after the hours set on the Quarantine page, which is also where the address the links point at is set - without that address nothing is sent. An empty digest is never sent, and each message says how to stop it.
data.value: 给本域名中新近有邮件被扣留的每个账户发送一封邮件，列出被扣留的邮件，并附上投递它们的链接。链接只能用一次，并在 隔离 页面设置的小时数过后失效；链接指向的地址也在该页面设置——没有这个地址就不会发送任何内容。空的摘要永远不会发送，每封邮件都会说明如何停止接收。

data.name: One point per {0}, from the {1}-day history the server keeps. Throughput is the change in the processed-messages total per minute.

data.name: Only needed when the key file is encrypted: with an encrypted key and no passphrase, the key does not load (server error 6170) and every TLS port using this certificate does not start - inbound mail on those ports stops. data.name: POP3 has no way for the server to tell a client that mail has arrived, so clients that want to look responsive poll - and some poll every few seconds. Each poll is a new connection, a TLS handshake and a password verification, which with Argon2id is deliberately expensive, so a handful of eager clients can cost more than the mail does. Setting a delay tells clients the interval in the server's capability list and refuses logins that arrive early with a code the client understands as "slow down" rather than as a wrong password.
data.value: POP3 没有办法让服务器告诉客户端邮件已到达，因此想要显得灵敏的客户端会轮询 - 有些每隔几秒就轮询一次。每次轮询都是一个新连接、一次 TLS 握手和一次密码验证，而用 Argon2id 时密码验证是有意昂贵的，因此少数几个急切的客户端的开销可能比邮件本身还大。设置延迟会在服务器的能力列表中告知客户端间隔，并用客户端理解为“慢一点”而不是“密码错误”的代码拒绝过早到达的登录。

data.name: Port 25 is judged differently from the rest and deliberately so: the peer there is normally another mail server, and requiring encryption on it refuses mail from senders that cannot offer any. On every other port the peer is a client with a password.
data.value: 端口 25 的判定标准与其他端口不同，而且是有意如此：那里的对端通常是另一台邮件服务器，在它上面要求加密会拒绝来自无法提供任何加密的发件方的邮件。在其他所有端口上，对端都是带密码的客户端。

data.name: Port 25 is where other servers deliver mail, and no mail client should sign in there. Off and Honeypot never look at a password: AUTH is answered 502, and the first one of a session bans the address for the auto-ban minutes - never this computer, nor an address on the never-ban lists. Honeypot goes on offering AUTH, as bait. Mail clients sign in on 587.
data.value: 端口 25 是其他服务器投递邮件的端口，任何邮件客户端都不应在那里登录。“关闭”和“蜜罐”从不查看密码：AUTH 一律答复 502，会话中的第一个 AUTH 会在自动封禁的分钟数内封禁该地址——但从不封禁本机，也不封禁永不封禁列表中的地址。“蜜罐”继续提供 AUTH，作为诱饵。邮件客户端在 587 登录。

data.name: Port 25 is where other servers deliver mail, and no mail client should sign in there: an AUTH on it is a password being guessed.
