data.name: Put "{0}" ({1}, {2}) back into the mailbox of {3}?

Put a load balancer, a TLS terminator or a Postfix relay in front of the SMTP listener and every connection appears to come from IT - which silently breaks DNSBL checks, SPF, greylisting, auto-ban and the IP range rules all at once, while everything still reports success. These let a named upstream pass on the real client address. Both are off by default and trust nobody until an address is listed, because a peer that can rewrite its own source address has defeated every IP-based control on this server. The upstream has to be configured to send it or nothing here changes: HAProxy needs send-proxy or send-proxy-v2 on its server line, and a Postfix relay needs XCLIENT enabled towards this host. hMailServer cannot check that from here - and note that once an address is listed as a PROXY protocol proxy the header becomes REQUIRED from it, so a proxy that does not send one will have its connections dropped.
data.value: 在 SMTP 监听器前面放一个负载均衡器、TLS 终结器或 Postfix 中继，那么每个连接看起来都来自它 - 这会悄悄地同时破坏 DNSBL 检查、SPF、灰名单、自动封禁和 IP 范围规则，而一切仍然报告成功。这些设置让指定的上游传递真实的客户端地址。两者默认都关闭，并且在列出地址之前不信任任何人，因为能改写自己源地址的对端已经击败了本服务器上所有基于 IP 的控制。上游必须配置为发送它，否则此处什么都不会改变：HAProxy 需要在其 server 行上加 send-proxy 或 send-proxy-v2，Postfix 中继需要对本主机启用 XCLIENT。hMailServer 无法从此处检查这一点 - 并且请注意，一旦某个地址被列为 PROXY 协议代理，就会要求它必须发送该标头，因此不发送标头的代理的连接会被丢弃。

data.name: READ THIS FIRST: IMAP, POP3 and SMTP have no way to change a password, and the self-service portal refuses an expired one at sign-in like every other surface. An expired password is therefore renewed by an administrator - or by the person themselves only if they hold an app password, which still signs them in to the portal, where the expired password is accepted as the current one when setting a new one. Turning this on means someone has to be available for everybody else. Existing app passwords keep working, which is also the one way an affected person can still collect mail; Active Directory accounts are exempt, because their password lives in the directory and expires by its policy, not this one. The clock started when this server was upgraded, so nobody is expired the moment you set this.
data.value: 请先阅读：IMAP、POP3 和 SMTP 都没有更改密码的途径，而自助服务门户与其他所有入口一样，会在登录时拒绝已过期的密码。因此，过期的密码由管理员来更新 - 或者由本人更新，但前提是本人持有应用密码：应用密码仍能登录门户，在那里设置新密码时，过期的密码会被当作当前密码接受。打开此项意味着必须有人随时能为其他所有人做这件事。现有的应用密码继续有效，这也是受影响的人仍能收取邮件的唯一途径；Active Directory 账户不受此限，因为它们的密码在目录中，按目录的策略过期，而不是按这个。计时从本服务器升级时开始，因此在您设置此项的那一刻不会有任何人过期。

data.name:
Recalculate the IMAP folder UID counters?
For every folder, the counter is moved up to the highest message UID that folder actually holds. Counters that are already correct or ahead are left alone, and no message is changed.
Run this if clients report messages appearing under the wrong UID, or after restoring a database.
data.value:
是否重新计算 IMAP 文件夹的 UID 计数器？
对每个文件夹，计数器都会上调到该文件夹实际持有的最大邮件 UID。已经正确或已经领先的计数器保持不动，也不会更改任何邮件。

data.name: Receivers look up the PTR record of the connecting IP address and compare it with the name the server announces in HELO/EHLO; this server judges incoming mail by the same standard when the PTR and HELO checks on Anti-spam settings are on. Unlike every other record on this page, the PTR is NOT published in your domain's zone: it lives in the reverse zone of the IP address, which belongs to whoever owns the address - usually your hosting provider or ISP. Ask them to set it; there is nothing to paste into your own DNS console.

data.name: Records a queryable row for every delivery, refusal and quarantine, so "what happened to the message Jane sent at 14:20" can be answered by searching instead of grepping logs. The events are the same ones the AWStats journal has always seen; this gives them somewhere to be asked questions. Off by default, because it stores sender and recipient addresses - which makes it a record of who corresponds with whom.
data.value: 为每一次投递、拒绝和隔离记录一行可查询的数据，这样“Jane 在 14:20 发的那封邮件到底怎么样了”就可以通过搜索来回答，而不必去 grep 日志。这些事件与 AWStats 日志一直以来看到的是同一批；此功能只是给它们一个可以被提问的地方。默认关闭，因为它会存储发件人和收件人地址 - 这就使它成为一份谁与谁通信的记录。

data.name: Records the SPF verdict for each accepted inbound message as a Received-SPF header (RFC 7208 section 9.1). The header is only written when the SPF check actually ran, so 'Check SPF' must be enabled on the Anti-spam settings page for it to appear.
data.value: 把每封被接受的入站邮件的 SPF 判定结果记录为一个 Received-SPF 标头（RFC 7208 第 9.1 节）。只有在 SPF 检查确实运行过时才会写入该标头，因此必须在“反垃圾邮件设置”页上启用“检查 SPF”，它才会出现。

data.name: Records the verdicts this server itself reached about each inbound message - SPF, DKIM and DMARC - as trace headers on the delivered message, for downstream filters and diagnostics (RFC 8601, RFC 7208).
data.value: 把本服务器自己对每封入站邮件作出的判定 - SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC - 作为跟踪标头写在投递的邮件上，供下游过滤器和诊断使用（RFC 8601、RFC 7208）。

data.name:
Replace ALL IP ranges with the defaults?
Every custom range - including any auto-ban entries - will be removed and replaced with 'My computer' (127.0.0.1) and 'Internet' (everything else). This changes who may connect and relay, immediately.

是否将所有 IP 范围替换为默认值？
每一个自定义范围 - 包括所有自动封禁条目 - 都会被移除，并替换为 'My computer'（127.0.0.1）和 'Internet'（其余全部）。这会立即改变谁可以连接和中继。

data.name:
Replace ALL configured ports with the defaults?
SMTP 25 and 587, POP3 110, IMAP 143 - without connection security, and with SMTP authentication On on both SMTP ports, so a port 25 that is a honeypot takes AUTH again. TLS ports and custom bindings will be removed. The change takes effect when the server is reinitialised.

data.name: Runs the same steps the server runs, in the same order, using the values in the editors above as they stand: connect, protect the transport, bind the service credential, search for the user - and, only if a password is typed below, bind as that user to prove it. The password is used once and never stored, and the test refuses to run any configuration that would put a password on the network unprotected. One honest caveat: the test runs from this computer, so a firewall that treats this machine and the hMailServer service differently can make the two disagree.
data.value: 按服务器所用的相同顺序执行相同的步骤，并直接使用上面各编辑框中当前的值：连接、保护传输、绑定服务凭据、搜索用户 - 并且只有在下面输入了密码时，才以该用户的身份绑定来加以证实。密码只使用一次，绝不存储，而且只要某项配置会让密码不加保护地经过网络，测试就会拒绝运行。有一点必须坦白说明：测试是从这台计算机上运行的，因此如果防火墙对这台机器和 hMailServer 服务区别对待，两者的结果就可能不一致。

Allowed: not greylisted and never refused on the spam score, while every test still runs and logs. Blocked: refused at MAIL FROM before greylisting, scoring or any lookup. Matched on the envelope sender's domain, the HELO name, or either; inbound unauthenticated sessions only.

data.name: Sends daily aggregate reports about TLS connection failures to recipient domains (RFC 8460).
data.value: 向收件人域发送关于 TLS 连接失败的每日汇总报告 (RFC 8460)。

data.name: Sends the commands of a transaction without waiting for each answer, which removes a round trip per recipient - the difference is largest on a slow link or to a distant server. Used only with a server that advertises it.
data.value: 发送一次事务的各条命令而不等待每一个应答，这样每个收件人就少一次往返 - 在缓慢的链路上或发往远处的服务器时差别最大。只对通告了它的服务器使用。

data.name: Sends the daily aggregate reports that domains ask for with a rua= tag in their DMARC record (RFC 7489) - who sent mail claiming to be them, and whether it passed. Reports only go to an address outside the policy domain when that address's own DNS says it wants them, so a domain cannot use its DMARC record to aim this server's reports at somebody else.
data.value: 发送各域通过其 DMARC 记录中的 rua= 标签请求的每日汇总报告 (RFC 7489) - 谁声称是它们在发送邮件，以及是否通过。只有当策略域之外的地址自身的 DNS 表示希望接收时，报告才会发往该地址，因此一个域无法利用其 DMARC 记录把本服务器的报告引向别人。

data.name: Sends the message as counted chunks rather than dot-stuffed DATA. It is also what carries a binary message onward without rewriting it: a message accepted as BINARYMIME can only be relayed as it arrived to a server that offers both this and BINARYMIME.
data.value: 把邮件作为计数的分块发送，而不是使用经过点填充的 DATA。它也正是在不重写邮件的情况下把二进制邮件继续送出去的手段：以 BINARYMIME 接受的邮件，只能按其到达时的原样中继给同时提供本项和 BINARYMIME 的服务器。

data.name: Sends the message to the engine at {0} and adds the score it answers; an answer of reject adds {1}.
data.value: 将邮件发送到 {0} 处的引擎，并加上它返回的分数；回答 reject 时加 {1}。

data.name: Sends the recipient's address as the User: header, so spamd applies that mailbox's own preferences - the shape a virtual-user spamd (--virtual-config-dir with %u or %d) expects. A scan runs once per message, not once per recipient, so a message to several people cannot be scanned under any one of their preferences and uses the profile above instead.
data.value: 将收件人的地址作为 User: 标头发送，这样 spamd 就会应用该邮箱自己的偏好设置 - 这是虚拟用户 spamd (带 %u 或 %d 的 --virtual-config-dir) 所期望的形式。扫描按每封邮件运行一次，而不是按每个收件人一次，因此发给多人的邮件无法按其中任何一人的偏好扫描，而是改用上面的配置文件。

data.name: Slows a session that names more recipients than a legitimate message needs. Past the count, every further RCPT TO in an unauthenticated session waits the delay before it is answered - a dictionary attack or a spam run names hundreds of addresses and pays for each one, while a sending MTA names a handful and never reaches the count. Authenticated sessions and IP ranges with spam protection off are exempt. The wait is a timer on the connection, not a thread asleep. Takes effect at once.
data.value: 减慢指定收件人数量超出正常邮件所需的会话。超过该数量后，未验证会话中的每个后续 RCPT TO 都要等待延迟后才被应答 - 字典攻击或垃圾邮件群发会指定数百个地址并为每一个付出代价，而正常的发送 MTA 只指定寥寥几个，永远达不到该数量。已验证会话和关闭了垃圾邮件防护的 IP 范围不受影响。等待是连接上的计时器，不是休眠的线程。立即生效。

data.name: The archive folder is a raw copy of every message that passes through the server, and until now nothing ever removed anything from it - so on a busy server it is a directory that only grows, and the administrator who finds out is the one whose disk filled up. This prunes it. 0 keeps everything, and that is the default on purpose: an archive is usually kept for a legal or contractual reason, and a server that started deleting from one on upgrade would be destroying exactly what it was told to keep. The sweep only ever removes .eml files, so anything else you keep in the archive is left alone, and it runs at startup and every twelve hours after.
data.value: 存档文件夹保存的是经过服务器的每一封邮件的原始副本，而直到现在都没有任何机制从中删除任何东西 - 因此在繁忙的服务器上，它是一个只增不减的目录，而发现这一点的管理员往往就是磁盘被写满的那一位。此项会对它进行清理。0 表示保留全部，而且这是刻意为之的默认值：保留存档通常出于法律或合同上的原因，而一台在升级后开始从中删除内容的服务器，恰恰会销毁它被要求保留的东西。清理只会删除 .eml 文件，因此您在存档中保存的其他内容不会被动；它在启动时运行，此后每十二小时运行一次。

data.name: The counterpart to ARC sealing: on inbound mail, a valid ARC chain from a trusted sealer can offset the DMARC failure score for a message whose DMARC pass was destroyed by forwarding (RFC 8617). It is configured on the Anti-spam settings page's Sender auth tab, because it is stored with the other anti-spam settings rather than in hMailServer.INI. With the trusted-sealer list empty the feature does nothing at all, by design: anyone can fabricate an entire ARC chain and seal it with keys published in their own DNS, and it will validate perfectly, so a passing chain proves nothing unless you already trust the sealer. The list is not an option of the feature - it is the feature. The offset never exceeds the DMARC failure score, and applies only while DMARC scoring is enabled on the Anti-spam settings page.
data.value: ARC 密封的对应功能: 对于入站邮件，来自受信任密封者的有效 ARC 链可以抵消因转发而破坏了 DMARC 通过结果的邮件的 DMARC 失败分数 (RFC 8617)。它在“反垃圾邮件设置”页的“发件人身份验证”选项卡上配置，因为它与其他反垃圾邮件设置一起存储，而不是存放在 hMailServer.INI 中。受信任密封者列表为空时，此功能有意什么也不做: 任何人都可以伪造一整条 ARC 链，并用发布在自己 DNS 中的密钥密封它，而它会完美地通过验证，所以除非您已经信任该密封者，否则通过验证的链什么也证明不了。这个列表不是该功能的一个选项 - 它就是该功能本身。抵消量永远不会超过 DMARC 失败分数，并且仅在“反垃圾邮件设置”页上启用了 DMARC 评分时才生效。

data.name: The delivery that takes a mailbox past this percentage produces one notice to the person whose mailbox it is, from their own domain's postmaster. ONE, not one per message: the server treats the threshold as something the mailbox CROSSES rather than a state it is in, so a mailbox sitting at 95% is not warned about again on every delivery - which would fill it faster than the mail does. Emptying the mailbox and filling it again warns again, which is the behaviour anyone would expect and is free here rather than something that had to be remembered and expired. On by default, because the alternative is what this server did before: say nothing at all until mail starts being refused, by which point the person it happens to is the last to know.
data.value: 使邮箱越过此百分比的那次投递，会以该邮箱所属域的 postmaster 名义向邮箱所有者发出一条通知。只有一条，而不是每封邮件一条: 服务器把阈值当作邮箱“越过”的一条线，而不是它所处的一种状态，因此停留在 95% 的邮箱不会在每次投递时都被再次警告 - 那样填满邮箱的速度会比邮件本身还快。清空邮箱再重新填满会再次警告，这是任何人都会预期的行为，而且在这里无需记录和过期机制就自然实现了。默认开启，因为另一种做法就是本服务器以前的做法: 在邮件开始被拒绝之前什么也不说，而到那时，受影响的人是最后一个知道的。

data.name: The groups this server will agree a TLS key with, in OpenSSL's list form. As shipped it offers the two post-quantum hybrids first and falls back to X25519 and the NIST curves for a peer that has neither, so nothing changes for an older client. An empty list, or one OpenSSL rejects or that would leave no group enabled, is not applied: the server logs it and uses the classical fallback, so a mistake here cannot take TLS down - but it does silently give up the hybrids, which is why the shipped list is shown rather than a blank. Change it against a scan rather than in the dark.
data.value: 本服务器愿意用来协商 TLS 密钥的群组，采用 OpenSSL 的列表格式。出厂设置会先提供两个后量子混合群组，对于两者都不支持的对端则回退到 X25519 和 NIST 曲线，因此对较旧的客户端来说没有任何变化。空列表、OpenSSL 拒绝的列表，或者会导致没有任何群组可用的列表都不会被应用：服务器会将其记入日志并使用经典回退列表，因此这里的错误不会让 TLS 瘫痪 - 但它会悄悄放弃混合群组，这正是此处显示出厂列表而不是空白的原因。请对照一次扫描的结果来更改它，而不是在两眼一抹黑的情况下更改。

data.name: The guided path: which half, which log lines, and the setting that bounds each stage.

data.name: The hMailServer 6.x line is one such effort. The original open-source mail server has been rebuilt on a current toolchain (Visual Studio 2026 / MSVC v145 and .NET 10), re-armed with modern cryptography (PBKDF2 / Argon2id, SCRAM-SHA-256, OAuth2) and the transport-security standards expected of a mail server today (DANE + DNSSEC, MTA-STS, ARC, Ed25519 DKIM, TLS-RPT and ACME / Let's Encrypt). It has been hardened against protocol and denial-of-service defects, given Sieve / ManageSieve filtering, health and OpenTelemetry observability, broad MySQL / MariaDB / MS SQL / PostgreSQL support, and this modern Fluent-design Control Panel in place of the legacy administrator.
data.value: hMailServer 6.x 系列就是这样一项努力。这个原始的开源邮件服务器已在当前工具链 (Visual Studio 2026 / MSVC v145 和 .NET 10) 上重建，重新配备了现代密码学 (PBKDF2 / Argon2id、SCRAM-SHA-256、OAuth2) 以及当今邮件服务器所应具备的传输安全标准 (DANE + DNSSEC、MTA-STS、ARC、Ed25519 DKIM、TLS-RPT 和 ACME / Let's Encrypt)。它针对协议和拒绝服务缺陷进行了加固，加入了 Sieve / ManageSieve 过滤、健康检查和 OpenTelemetry 可观测性、对 MySQL / MariaDB / MS SQL / PostgreSQL 的广泛支持，以及这个取代旧版管理器的 Fluent 设计的现代控制面板。

data.name: The last five settings on this card are for a site that builds its own releases and signs them with its own Sigstore, or that mirrors this project's. Leave every one of them empty and the server trusts only an installer signed by one of this project's two release workflows - the GitHub one for the releases up to 6.3.3, the GitLab one for the releases after - and recorded in the public transparency log. Setting any of them narrows or replaces that for both, and getting one wrong means either refusing genuine releases or trusting somebody else's.

data.name: The single value AEAD-ONLY (case-insensitive) is a named preset rather than an OpenSSL cipher string: forward-secret AEAD suites only (ECDHE or DHE with AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305), excluding every CBC-mode suite - the Lucky13 padding-oracle family - and static-RSA key exchange. The cost: TLS 1.2 clients that only speak CBC suites cannot connect, and TLS 1.0/1.1 are left with no usable cipher at all, so do not enable those protocols alongside it. TLS 1.3 is unaffected - its suites are AEAD by construction and are configured separately below. A misspelled preset name is rejected and reported, not silently ignored.
data.value: 单一值 AEAD-ONLY (不区分大小写) 是一个具名预设而不是 OpenSSL 密码字符串: 只有前向保密的 AEAD 套件 (使用 AES-GCM 或 ChaCha20-Poly1305 的 ECDHE 或 DHE)，排除所有 CBC 模式套件 - Lucky13 填充预言机一族 - 以及静态 RSA 密钥交换。代价是: 只会 CBC 套件的 TLS 1.2 客户端无法连接，而 TLS 1.0/1.1 完全没有可用的密码，因此不要在它旁边启用这些协议。TLS 1.3 不受影响 - 其套件在设计上就是 AEAD，并在下面单独配置。拼错的预设名称会被拒绝并报告，而不是被悄悄忽略。

data.name: These belong together: expiry without history teaches people to alternate between two passwords, which is worse than not expiring at all. data.name: This project's installers have been Authenticode-signed since 6.3.1, by Progressive Robot Ltd through Azure Artifact Signing; the releases before 6.3.1 carry no signature, and this refuses them. It checks, when an installer is downloaded, that Windows trusts the signature - WinVerifyTrust against this machine's trusted roots, with no revocation check - and not who made it: that is the job of the Sigstore signature, which every release carries and which is checked either way.
data.value: 本项目的安装程序自 6.3.1 起由 Progressive Robot Ltd 通过 Azure Artifact Signing 进行 Authenticode 签名；6.3.1 之前的发行版没有签名，此项会拒绝它们。下载安装程序时，它检查的是 Windows 是否信任该签名（针对本机受信任根证书的 WinVerifyTrust，不检查吊销），而不是谁签的名：那是 Sigstore 签名的职责，每个发行版都带有它，并且无论如何都会被检查。

data.name: This runs before virus scanning and independently of it: it applies even with every scanner switched off, and it applies to messages the size limit above would skip. A matched attachment is replaced by a short text file explaining the removal rather than being deleted outright, so the recipient can tell something was taken out.
data.value: 这在病毒扫描之前独立运行: 即使所有扫描器都关闭它也生效，并且对上面大小限制会跳过的邮件也生效。匹配的附件会被替换为一个说明移除原因的短文本文件，而不是直接删除，这样收件人能知道有东西被取走了。

data.name: This runs while the sending server waits for its answer to DATA, so the number is a promise about the worst case rather than a hint. It bounds the connection as well as the reply: an engine whose machine has gone away would otherwise cost the operating system's own TCP timeout on every message.
data.value: 这在发送方服务器等待其 DATA 应答时运行，因此这个数字是对最坏情况的承诺，而不是提示。它既限制连接也限制应答: 否则一台机器已经消失的引擎会在每封邮件上耗掉操作系统自身的 TCP 超时。

data.name: This setting lives on each IP range rather than with the rest of TLS, which is the main reason it goes unnoticed. It is the only control that refuses a plaintext password regardless of what the port allows, so it is what makes an optional-STARTTLS port safe for clients.

A sender the reader marked safe is exempt, and so is a sender domain that is itself hosted here or a partner.

The name mta-sts.{0} also needs an A or CNAME record pointing at this server, and the listener's certificate must cover that name.

data.name: UDP truncates an entry to 1024 bytes, which is RFC 5426's guidance and is under every path MTU that matters; the two stream transports frame each entry with its own length (RFC 5425) and truncate nothing. data.name: What rotation defends: OpenSSL's default ticket key is generated once, when the listener starts, and is never rotated, so every ticket that listener issues for the life of the process is sealed under the same key - and that key, recovered later, decrypts every ticket ever recorded. With an interval set, a captured ticket is useless after at most two intervals. 86400 is a day. Only meaningful while session tickets are enabled above.
data.value: 轮换防范的是什么: OpenSSL 的默认票据密钥在监听器启动时生成一次，之后永不轮换，因此该监听器在进程整个生命周期内签发的每张票据都用同一个密钥密封 - 而这个密钥一旦事后被恢复，就能解密曾经记录下来的每一张票据。设置了间隔后，被截获的票据最多在两个间隔后就失效。86400 是一天。仅在上面启用了会话票据时才有意义。

data.name: What stops one statement blocked on a lock from holding a worker thread for ever. Honoured at connect time by MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL; MS SQL and SQL CE start at ADO's own 30 seconds and pick this value up on any connection that has run an upgrade or maintenance script. Those scripts run under a 30-minute per-statement ceiling of their own regardless of this value.
data.value: 是什么阻止一条被锁阻塞的语句永远占用一个工作线程。MySQL/MariaDB 和 PostgreSQL 在连接时遵守它；MS SQL 和 SQL CE 从 ADO 自己的 30 秒开始，并在任何运行过升级或维护脚本的连接上采用此值。这些脚本无论此值如何，都在其自身每条语句 30 分钟的上限下运行。

data.name: Which Windows account the hMailServer service logs on as. A new installation uses NT SERVICE\hMailServer, a virtual account of its own that needs no password and reaches only the folders it is granted; an installation upgraded from an earlier version keeps LocalSystem, the most privileged account on the machine, until it is moved - and under LocalSystem a flaw reachable through SMTP, IMAP or POP3 would have full control of the computer.

Linux: the packaged autoban-hook keeps an nftables set with a timeout, and the service needs CAP_NET_ADMIN for it - the hook says exactly how to grant it. List the addresses you administer from under never-ban first.

data.name: With the manager on, the list answers its own addresses - its -subscribe, -unsubscribe, -request, -owner and -bounces addresses - and sends each member a copy of their own, with their own way to leave. Each member's delivery and bounces are shown in the Control Deck.

data.name: With this on, MAIL FROM in an authenticated session must be the account's own address, an alias that resolves to it, or another mailbox whose owner has granted the account the post (p) right on their INBOX - which is how Send-As for a shared mailbox is granted, from any IMAP client's ACL editor (SETACL) or over the COM API. Anything else is refused with 550 5.7.1 before a byte of the message is accepted, so one compromised or careless account can no longer send as every other. Off by default because nothing constrained this before and an installation may depend on that; the null sender is always allowed. Unauthenticated sessions are unaffected.
data.value: 开启后，已验证会话中的 MAIL FROM 必须是账户自己的地址、解析到它的别名，或所有者已向该账户授予其 INBOX 上投递 (p) 权限的另一个邮箱 - 共享邮箱的“代表发送”就是这样授予的，可通过任何 IMAP 客户端的 ACL 编辑器 (SETACL) 或通过 COM API。其他任何情况都会在接受邮件的第一个字节之前以 550 5.7.1 拒绝，因此一个被攻陷或粗心的账户再也不能冒充所有其他账户发送。默认关闭，因为以前没有任何东西限制这一点，现有安装可能依赖它；空发件人始终允许。未验证的会话不受影响。

data.name: Write-only: a stored password is never shown here again - leave the box blank to keep it. It is stored as plain text in hMailServer.INI on the server, because the server has to present it to the directory verbatim and so cannot hash it; restrict file access to the INI accordingly. It only ever leaves the server over the transport configured above.

data.name: Writes the conditions an operator alerts on - database unavailable, a listener that would not start, a crash, a failed backup, the disk floor - to the Windows Application log, where Event Viewer, monitoring agents and SIEM collectors can see them. Each condition has an event id of its own that does not change, so an alert can match on it; a healthy server writes nothing at all. Protocol traffic and routine logging never go here - a mail server that logs every session to the Application log gets itself uninstalled.
data.value: 把运维人员会据以告警的情况 - 数据库不可用、无法启动的监听器、崩溃、失败的备份、磁盘下限 - 写入 Windows 应用程序日志，事件查看器、监控代理和 SIEM 收集器都能在那里看到它们。每种情况都有自己固定不变的事件 id，告警可以据此匹配；健康的服务器什么都不会写。协议流量和常规日志绝不会写到这里 - 一台把每个会话都记入应用程序日志的邮件服务器，最后会把自己搞到被卸载。

data.name: hMailServer does NOT implement CalDAV or CardDAV. These settings only answer the well-known discovery URLs (RFC 6764) with a redirect to the server that does, so a client configured with a user's mail address finds their calendar without being told a second address. Leave both empty unless you run such a server: empty means the discovery URLs answer 404, which is the honest response when there is nothing to point at. They need the web services listener above to be running, like everything else on this page.
data.value: hMailServer 并不实现 CalDAV 或 CardDAV。这些设置只是用一个指向确实实现了它们的服务器的重定向来应答众所周知的发现 URL（RFC 6764），这样用用户邮件地址配置好的客户端不必再被告知第二个地址就能找到其日历。除非您确实运行着这样一台服务器，否则请把两者都留空：留空意味着发现 URL 应答 404，而在没有任何可指向的目标时，这才是诚实的回应。与本页上的其他一切一样，它们需要上面的 Web 服务监听器处于运行状态。

data.name: hMailServer does not create or manage client certificates. The certificate authority and the client certificates themselves must be produced outside hMailServer (for example with OpenSSL or an internal PKI) - the server only trusts the CA bundle it is given here.
data.value: hMailServer 既不创建也不管理客户端证书。证书颁发机构和客户端证书本身都必须在 hMailServer 之外产生（例如使用 OpenSSL 或内部 PKI）- 服务器只信任此处提供给它的 CA 证书包。

data.name: mail.example.net is that name alone; .example.net is the name and every name beneath it. The reverse lookup is never waited for on a connection: a ban placed before the answer is in is lifted once it is, before the firewall or fail2ban is told. A net with no reverse name, or one you do not trust, still belongs in the address list above.
data.value: mail.example.net 仅表示该名称；.example.net 表示该名称及其下的所有名称。连接过程中从不等待反向查询：在应答到达之前设下的封禁，会在应答到达后、通知防火墙或 fail2ban 之前解除。没有反向名称、或反向名称不可信的网络，仍应列入上方的地址列表。

data.name: p=none is the right starting point, not an oversight: it makes receivers check and report but deliver as normal. A stricter policy (quarantine or reject) tells every receiver to junk or refuse mail that fails alignment - and until reports show your own mail passing SPF or DKIM, the mail that fails will include yours. Tighten only after the reports say it is safe.
data.value: p=none 是正确的起点，而不是疏漏：它让接收方进行检查并发送报告，但照常投递。更严格的策略（quarantine 或 reject）会告诉每一个接收方把对齐失败的邮件丢进垃圾箱或直接拒收 - 而在报告显示您自己的邮件能通过 SPF 或 DKIM 之前，失败的邮件里就会有您自己的。只有在报告说安全之后再收紧。
